en: The boy dabs his brush on the canvas, and the steam train in his painting comes alive, chugging along the rails and puffing smoke, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a brush stroke and a tiny train 'choo-choo'.

vi: Hai bạn từ xa hơn trên con đường chạy thật lại gần, tới đúng chỗ và dáng như tranh; hoa trắng rơi, chim én bay; cây đứng yên.
en: Running animation from the first frame to the last: the two children run forward along the path toward the viewer, really coming closer and a little larger with each stride, laughing, until they reach exactly their places and running poses in the final illustration. White blossoms drift down from the tree and the swallows dart across the sky inside the picture; the tree trunk and the camera stay still. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: running footsteps, children's laughter and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the two children: the same boy and girl are just a few steps further back along the path behind them, almost the same size, still running and fully inside the picture. Keep exactly the same tree, blossoms, birds, paper background and style.
Keep the same paper background and style, but show only a small young cabbage with a few open leaves, no tight head.
vi: Bắp cải non cuộn lá từng lớp, lớn tròn thành bắp.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the young leaves curl inward layer by layer, the head grows round and firm and the outer leaves spread until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft leafy rustling.

vi: Cá mập lao lên khỏi sóng, há miệng đớp “phập”, sóng tung trắng xoá.
en: The shark surges through the waves, snaps its jaws shut with a chomp, white spray flies, then it opens its mouth again into the exact original pose. Sound: crashing waves and a big 'chomp'.

vi: Các bạn gõ sào nhịp nhàng, hai bạn nhảy sạp qua lại.
en: The kneeling children clap the bamboo poles together in rhythm while the two dancers hop nimbly in and out between them, the flowers above sway, then everyone settles back to the original picture. Sound: rhythmic bamboo clacks 'clack-clack' and happy cheers (no words).

vi: Xe đạp tự lăn chậm tới chỗ trong tranh, bánh lăn đúng theo quãng đường đi, dừng lại, chân chống gạt xuống "cạch", xe nghiêng đúng như tranh, cần chuông gật hai cái "kính coong".
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the bicycle rolls slowly forward by itself a short distance to the right, its wheels turning only as much as it travels, comes to a stop, the kickstand flips down with a 'clack' and the bike leans onto it exactly as in the final illustration; then the bell lever flicks twice, 'ring ring'. The wheels turn only while the bike is rolling; the frame stays rigid metal. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: soft tire rolling, a kickstand clack and a bright bicycle bell 'ring ring'. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the bicycle's position and stand: the same bicycle is a little further to the left (still fully inside the picture), standing upright on its wheels with the kickstand folded up. Same bicycle, colors and basket, same paper background and style.

vi: Bé ngồi dậy vươn vai, ngoài sân gà trống gáy, trâu vẫy đuôi.
en: The girl sits up in bed, stretches her arms with a big yawn, outside the rooster crows and the buffalo swishes its tail, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: a rooster crow, a yawn (no words), morning birds.

vi: Hổ trên tảng đá gầm vang, quất đuôi.
en: The tiger on the rock roars mightily, its whiskers trembling and its tail lashing, then closes its mouth and opens it back into the exact original pose. Sound: a powerful tiger roar.

vi: Tia chớp loé, sấm rền, mưa gió quật cây.
en: A bright lightning bolt flashes from the dark cloud, the rain pours harder, the tree bends further in the wind and springs back, then it settles back to the original picture. Sound: a loud thunderclap rumble, heavy rain and howling wind.

vi: Ba bạn cầm sách hát, đung đưa theo nhịp (tiếng hát không lời).
en: The three children hold their songbooks and sway together in rhythm as if singing, mouths opening and closing, then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful children's humming melody without words.

vi: Cá chép quẫy đuôi xoè, bơi uốn lượn, râu ngoe nguẩy.
en: The carp swishes its big fan tail, swims in a graceful curve, its whiskers waving, then returns to the exact original pose. Sound: gentle water swishes and bubbles.

vi: Hai chiếc đèn lồng lắc lư, ánh nến bên trong toả sáng, tua đung đưa.
en: The two paper lanterns sway on the pole, a warm candle glow lights up inside them, the tassels swing, then everything settles back to the original picture. Sound: soft paper rustling and a gentle breeze.

vi: Đôi dép nhảy lên lạch bạch như đang bước đi rồi về chỗ cũ.
en: The pair of rubber sandals hop forward one after the other as if walking, slapping softly on the ground, then step back to the exact original position. Sound: rubber sandals flip-flopping.

start: Keep exactly the same composition, paper background, pond water line, colors and hand-drawn ink style, but remove the lotus completely (no stem, no leaf, no bud): only calm pond water with a few small ripples where the lotus will grow.
vi: Mầm sen nhú khỏi mặt nước, thân vươn, lá xoè, nụ hồng hiện ra.
en: Time-lapse growth animation from the first frame to the last: a tiny green lotus shoot pushes up out of the calm pond water, the long stem grows taller, a big round leaf unfolds, then a small bud forms and slowly swells and blushes pink until the image matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: gentle water ripples and soft rustling of growth.

start: Keep the same pond, leaves, buds, clouds, paper background and style, but the two open lotus flowers are closed pink buds on the same stalks, the same shape as the other buds.
vi: Đúng như hoa sen: hai nụ sen hồng trên cuống từ từ hé, từng lớp cánh mở ra, lộ đài sen vàng, nở thành hai bông sen như tranh; chuồn chuồn bay, lá sen rung, mây trôi.
en: Natural lotus blooming from the first frame to the last: the two pink lotus buds on their tall stalks slowly loosen, the outer petals open first, then the inner layers, revealing the yellow seed pod in the center, until they become the two open lotus flowers of the final illustration exactly; the flowers only open, they never close again. A dragonfly flies across, the big leaves sway in the breeze and the clouds drift. Time only moves forward. Sound: a soft breeze over water, a dragonfly buzz and frogs far away.

start: Keep the same river, banks, background and style, but show only the stone bridge pillars standing in the water, with no deck and no steel trusses.
vi: Dựng cầu đúng thứ tự: trên các trụ đá, từng nhịp được dựng lần lượt từ nhịp xa bên trái tới nhịp gần bên phải; mỗi nhịp đặt dầm mặt cầu nằm ngang trước, rồi khung thép vòm dựng lên trên mặt cầu, đến khi thành cây cầu như tranh.
en: Bridge-building animation from the first frame to the last, in the correct order, one span at a time, starting from the far left span and moving to the near right span: for each span, first the flat steel deck beam is lowered straight down from above and rests across the two neighbouring pillars, then the arched steel truss is assembled on top of that deck, its curved top chord and its vertical and diagonal beams appearing piece by piece; then the next span, until the whole bridge matches the final illustration exactly, the river flowing below. Nothing floats or swings around; every piece lands in its final place. Time only moves forward. Sound: metallic clanks and flowing water.

start: Keep the same bridge, river, trees, paper background and style, but move the whole line of traffic (the motorbike on the far left, the truck, the bus, the two motorbikes, the bicycle and the woman with the carrying pole) to the left by about one fifth of the frame width, so the far-left motorbike and part of the truck are cut off by the left edge and the right end of the bridge deck is empty; also move the small boat on the river a little to the left.
vi: Xe cộ chạy thật trên cầu từ trái sang phải: xe tải, xe buýt, xe máy, xe đạp, người gánh hàng đều tiến tới đúng chỗ trong tranh; thuyền nhỏ trôi dưới sông.
en: Traffic animation from the first frame to the last: the truck, the bus, the motorbikes and the bicycle roll forward to the right across the bridge, wheels turning, and the woman with the carrying pole walks forward to the right, her baskets swinging; everybody really travels across the bridge, nobody moves in place, and the small boat drifts to the right on the river below, until everything reaches its position and matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward, never rewinds and never reverses. Sound: traffic hum, a bicycle bell, a horn and flowing water.

vi: Gà trống vỗ cánh, vươn cổ gáy “ò ó o”.
en: The rooster flaps its wings, puffs its chest, stretches its neck up and crows loudly, does a little hop on the spot, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud, clear rooster crow and wing flaps.

vi: Lợn đang ngủ ngáy khò khò, hé một mắt, kêu "ụt ịt ụt ịt" vui vẻ, ngoáy đuôi, vẫy tai, rồi rúc vào ổ rơm ngủ tiếp, mỉm cười như tranh.
en: The plump pig sleeps on the straw, snoring softly with its belly rising and falling, then opens one eye, wiggles its snout and gives a few happy, loud piggy grunts 'oink oink', twitches its ears and curls its tail, then snuggles back into the straw and falls asleep again with a smile in a natural new movement, ending in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: clear, real, happy pig grunts and oinks, soft snores and rustling straw.

vi: Mèo đang liếm chân thì ngừng lại, ngẩng đầu, há miệng kêu "meo meo" hai tiếng rõ, rồi cúi xuống liếm chân tiếp như tranh.
en: The cat licks its paw, then pauses, lifts its head, opens its eyes, opens its mouth and gives two clear, sweet meows 'meow, meow', flicks its ears, then lowers its head and goes back to licking its paw in a natural new movement, ending in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: two clear, real cat meows and soft licking.

start: Keep the same paper background, pot, grass and flowers and style, but show the plant as an untrimmed, round, shaggy green bush with leaves sticking out everywhere, no bird shape yet.
vi: Bụi cây xù trong chậu được kéo vô hình tỉa dần, lá vụn bay, hiện thành con chim; chim lá rung mình như vừa sống dậy.
en: Shaping animation from the first frame to the last: invisible garden shears snip around the shaggy bush, little leaves fly off, and the bird shape appears bit by bit, head, beak and tail, until it matches the final illustration exactly; then the leafy bird gives a tiny ruffle as if alive. Sound: crisp shear snips, falling leaves and one soft chirp.

start: Keep the same paper background, leaves and style, but show only the stem with the green leaves and the small white flower, no peppers yet.
vi: Hoa ớt trắng nở, hai quả ớt non nhú ra và dài dần; một quả chín đỏ dần, quả kia vẫn xanh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small white flower opens, two tiny green chili peppers appear and grow long and glossy, then one of them slowly ripens from green to bright red while the other stays green, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft gentle growing sounds and a light pop.

vi: Chim nhỏ nhảy dọc tấm ván, bập bênh nghiêng lên xuống, chim vỗ cánh rồi đậu lại chỗ cũ.
en: The little bird hops along the wooden seesaw, the board tips down on its side and up again, the bird flaps and rides the bounce, then the seesaw settles and the bird lands back exactly in its original spot. Sound: a wooden creak, cheerful chirps and fluttering wings.

start: Keep the same canal, wooden bridge, coconut palms, paper background and style, but the two children are at the left end of the bridge, just stepping onto it, about one third of the bridge length further to the left than now.
vi: Hai bạn đi chậm qua cầu gỗ từ đầu cầu bên trái, dừng đúng chỗ giữa cầu như tranh, không đi quá; nước kênh lăn tăn, dừa đung đưa, cá nhảy.
en: Walking animation from the first frame to the last: the two children walk slowly forward to the right across the little wooden bridge with small, calm steps, really travelling along the bridge, the girl's basket swinging, and they come to a gentle stop exactly at their places in the middle of the bridge as in the final illustration; that spot in the middle of the bridge is where their walk ends. Below them the canal water ripples, a small fish leaps out with a splash and the coconut palms sway. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: footsteps on wooden planks, flowing water, a splash and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the position of the boy: the one single boy stands fully inside the picture near its left side (about one third of the picture width further left than now, his whole body visible, not cut by any edge), in a walking pose; same boy, clothes and backpack; the tree, bushes, flowers and background stay exactly the same.
vi: Máy quay và nền đứng yên; cậu học sinh đi thật từ phía trái tranh sang, dừng đúng chỗ, không đi quá; không chuyển cảnh mờ.
en: Walking animation from the first frame to the last: the camera and the whole background stay completely still (the tree, bushes and flowers stay in their places); only the schoolboy moves: he walks forward to the right with cheerful, bouncy steps, his backpack bouncing on his back, really travelling across the picture from the left side, and he stops exactly at his place in the final illustration, and that is where his walk ends. The whole clip is one continuous shot of the same picture. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: light footsteps on the path and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the bricks: there are no brick stacks in front yet (empty ground there), and a loose pile of fired bricks lies by the mouth of the kiln. Keep exactly the same kiln, roof, smoke, the one single worker, trees, paper background and style.
vi: Người thợ lấy gạch từ đống gạch bên miệng lò, bê từng viên đặt ngay ngắn, xếp chồng cao dần từng lớp thành hai chồng gạch như tranh; lửa trong lò bập bùng, khói cuộn bay.
en: Brick-stacking animation from the first frame to the last: the worker picks up bricks from the pile by the kiln mouth, carries them a step over and lays them down neatly one by one, building two brick stacks that clearly rise layer after layer, each new brick placed with a solid tap, while the fire inside the domed kiln glows and flickers and smoke curls up from the roof, until the two stacks and the worker match the final illustration exactly. Only the one worker in the picture appears; every brick is carried by his hands. The stacks grow one brick at a time. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: brick clacks, footsteps, crackling fire and a rooster far away. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Mẹ quét gọn đống lá, bé rửa chiếc bát, bọt xà phòng nổi lên, nước bắn tung toé nhẹ.
en: The mother sweeps with the straw broom and the little pile of leaves swirls away, the girl scrubs the bowl in the basin and soap bubbles float up and pop, then both settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: broom swishes, splashing water and popping bubbles.

vi: Hai chú chim chích hót ríu rít, nhảy trên cành tre; hai chị em chỉ trỏ cười thích thú.
en: The two little warblers chirp back and forth, hop along the bamboo branch and flutter their wings, the bamboo leaves sway, the two sisters point and smile with delight, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: lively warbler twittering and rustling bamboo.

vi: Ếch phồng túi kêu ộp ộp, nhảy một cú rồi đáp lại đúng chỗ cũ.
en: The spotted frog puffs out its throat and croaks twice, then crouches and makes a big jump, landing back exactly in its original spot and pose; the grass and flowers wiggle. Sound: loud frog croaks ribbit ribbit and a soft landing thump.

vi: Bóc lịch đúng chiều: tờ lịch trên cùng được nhấc từ mép dưới lên, lật ngược lên qua gáy lịch ở phía trên, bị xé ra rồi bay đi khỏi khung; tờ bên dưới hiện ra y như cũ.
en: Tearing off a day from the wall calendar: the top page lifts from its bottom edge and flips UP and back over the binding at the top (the pages are attached only at the top), it tears off with a crisp rip and flutters away out of the frame, revealing the next page underneath, which looks exactly like the original page, ending in the exact original picture. The pages never flip sideways or downward, and the calendar board itself does not move. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a crisp paper rip and a soft flutter. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Đồng hồ báo thức reo, rung lắc; bé ngẩng lên mỉm cười rồi lại chăm chú viết bài.
en: The alarm clock rings and shakes on the little table, its bells trembling, the girl looks up at it with a smile, then turns back and keeps writing carefully in her notebook, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a ringing alarm clock and a pencil scratching on paper.

vi: Chiếc xẻng tự xúc một nhát đất, hất đất lên rồi trở về đúng chỗ cũ.
en: The shovel comes alive: it digs into a small mound of soil that appears below it, scoops up a load, tosses the soil in a little arc, then the soil disappears and the shovel returns to the exact original position. Sound: a metal blade crunching into soil and falling dirt.

vi: Trang sách lật nhẹ, cái cây và bông hoa vẽ trong sách đung đưa, một con bướm bay ra khỏi trang rồi bay về.
en: The open book's pages flutter, the little tree and flowers drawn on the pages come alive and sway, a small butterfly flies out of the page, circles and flies back into the picture, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft page rustling and a gentle magical chime.

start: Keep the same mother, boy, stone, tree, paper background and style, but the boy is running upright toward the stone, mid-stride just before it, and the mother stands upright close by on the right, fully inside the picture, watching him. Only these two people.
vi: Mẹ có mặt suốt clip, đứng gần; bé chạy, vấp đá, ngã ngồi; mẹ bước tới cúi đỡ; clip dừng đúng tư thế tranh, bé không đứng dậy.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the mother stays visible the whole time, standing close by inside the picture; she is there in every frame. The boy runs, his foot catches on the stone, he trips and falls down sitting and leaning on his hands; the mother hurries the few steps over, bends down and reaches out to hold his arms, and the clip ends exactly in the pose of the final illustration, with the boy still on the ground and the mother bending to help him. The boy stays sitting on the ground at the end. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: quick running footsteps, a soft thump and a small surprised gasp. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same bamboo clump, leaves, grass, paper background and style, but at the foot of the bamboo there is only a small mound of brown soil at the foot of the bamboo where the shoots will be.
vi: Măng mọc sau mưa: mưa rơi lộp độp, đất nứt ra, búp măng nhọn đội đất nhú lên, lớn vụt, bẹ măng xếp lớp; một búp măng nhỏ nhú lên bên cạnh như tranh.
en: Bamboo shoot animation from the first frame to the last: the soil mound cracks open and the pointed tip of a bamboo shoot pushes up out of the earth and quickly grows tall and fat, its brown sheaths layering one over another, and a second small shoot pokes up beside it, until both shoots match the final illustration exactly. The shoots only grow. The bamboo clump stays fully visible and solid the whole time. Each shoot is a real bamboo shoot, a pointed cone wrapped in brown-yellow hairy sheaths; it stops growing exactly at its size in the picture; the small shoot pokes up afterwards. Time only moves forward. Sound: soft earthy cracking and rustling bamboo leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same trees, ground, sky and style, but show only the low concrete foundation of the building with no floors above it yet.
vi: Toà nhà mọc lên từng tầng, cửa sổ hiện dần, ban công gắn vào, đến khi thành nhà cao tầng.
en: Building animation from the first frame to the last: on the foundation the building rises floor by floor, windows and balconies appear on each new level, the roof caps the top, until the tall building matches the final illustration exactly; the trees in front sway. Sound: quick construction knocks and clinks, then birdsong.

vi: Cô giáo dẫn hàng học sinh bước đều, khăn quàng bay nhẹ, hàng cây đung đưa; trang nghiêm, nhẹ nhàng.
en: Calm and respectful: the teacher leads the line of pupils forward in neat, quiet steps, their red scarves flutter gently, the trees on both sides sway in the breeze, then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. The building stays exactly as drawn. Sound: soft footsteps and a light breeze, no music.

vi: Ba quả bóng bay bồng bềnh, chạm nhẹ vào nhau, dây nơ đung đưa.
en: The three balloons float and bob up and down, sway on their strings and gently bump into each other, the ribbon bow swings, then they return to the exact original position. Sound: soft rubbery squeaks and a light breeze.

start: Keep the same paper background, stem, leaves, small side bud and style, but show the main rose as a tight closed bud, no open petals.
vi: Nụ hồng hé dần, từng lớp cánh đỏ xoè ra thành bông hồng nở to.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: the closed rose bud slowly loosens and opens, red petals unfurl layer by layer from the outside in, until the full rose matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves tremble gently. Sound: a soft gentle rustle and a tiny sparkle.

vi: Đoàn tàu chạy qua cầu sắt xình xịch, thuyền nhỏ chèo trên sông, nước chảy, mây trôi.
en: The train rolls across the long steel bridge with a rhythmic clatter, the little boat rows along the river with ripples behind it, the water flows and the clouds drift, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: train wheels clacking on the bridge, a train horn and flowing water.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show green dong leaves laid flat and open in a square with a heap of white sticky rice and green mung beans in the middle, and loose bamboo strings lying beside it.
vi: Lá dong gấp lại bọc gạo đỗ thành khối vuông, lạt tre tự vòng quanh buộc chặt thành bánh chưng.
en: Wrapping animation from the first frame to the last: the flat dong leaves fold up around the sticky rice and beans, corner by corner, into a neat square, then the bamboo strings wrap around it and tie themselves tight, until the banh chung matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: rustling leaves and the creak of strings tightening.

vi: Hoa súng hé nở rộng thêm, lá súng dập dềnh, chuồn chuồn bay lướt, mặt nước gợn sóng.
en: The water lilies open a little wider, the round lily pads bob on the gentle ripples, a dragonfly zips across and touches the water, a small fish ripple spreads, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft lapping water, a dragonfly buzz and frogs far away.

vi: Các bạn nắm tay múa vòng tròn, bạn đánh trống tùng tùng, đèn ông sao đung đưa, trăng sáng tỏa.
en: The children hold hands and dance around in a circle, the boy beats the drum, the star lanterns sway and glow, the full moon shines brighter, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a festive drum tung tung, children's happy laughter and cheerful humming (no words).

vi: Cô gái hái thêm một bông sen, thuyền thúng chòng chành, nước lăn tăn, chuồn chuồn bay qua.
en: The girl in the round basket boat reaches out and picks a lotus flower, the basket boat rocks gently, ripples spread over the pond, the lotus leaves sway and a dragonfly flies past, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft water lapping, a paddle splash and a dragonfly buzz.

start: Keep the same paper background, ground and style, but show only a few short green sugarcane shoots with small leaves poking up from the soil, no tall stalk yet.
vi: Mầm mía nhú lên, thân mía vươn cao từng đốt, lá dài xoè ra đến khi thành khóm mía.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the short sugarcane shoots push up, the stalk grows tall joint by joint, the long leaves spread and arch out, until it matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves rustle in the wind. Sound: wooden creaks of growing cane and rustling leaves.

vi: Rùa chậm rãi bò vài bước, thụt đầu vào mai rồi thò ra, chớp mắt.
en: The turtle slowly crawls a few steps forward, pulls its head into its shell, then pokes it back out and blinks, then settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: soft shuffling on the ground and a tiny contented sigh.

start: Keep the same warm cream paper background color and style. Remove the big watermelon and the slice; in the same place there is only a small yellow watermelon flower on the vine with the same curly tendril and the same leaves, and in front, where the slice is, a small striped watermelon lies on the ground.
vi: Nền giấy vàng be giữ nguyên. Tại chỗ quả to: hoa vàng nở, đậu quả non, quả lớn dần thành quả dưa hấu to nguyên vẹn; quả nhỏ phía trước tự tách ra một miếng dưa đỏ như tranh. Dây và lá chỉ đung đưa.
en: Natural watermelon animation from the first frame to the last: the paper background keeps the same warm cream color the whole time. The small yellow flower on the vine opens, a tiny striped melon forms where it was and swells right there into the big round watermelon, which always stays whole; meanwhile the small melon in front splits open on its own and one red slice with black seeds settles in place, until everything matches the final illustration exactly. The vine and leaves stay and only sway. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a soft growing sound and a crisp juicy crack. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Đèn trên mũ quét ánh sáng, người thợ bổ cuốc chim vào vách than, than vụn rơi, xe goòng lăn nhẹ.
en: The miner's helmet lamp sweeps its beam across the coal wall, he swings the pickaxe and strikes the coal, a few black chunks tumble down with tiny sparks, the mine cart behind rolls a little, then he returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a pickaxe clink, falling coal and an echo in the tunnel.

vi: Cô diễn viên đi trên dây, chao nhẹ rồi giữ thăng bằng; khán giả nín thở rồi vỗ tay.
en: The tightrope walker steps carefully along the rope, wobbles a little and balances with the pole, the audience holds its breath and then claps, the striped tent flags flutter, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a circus drum roll, a gasp and applause (no words).

start: Keep the same folded card shape, paper background and style, but show the card completely plain and blank, with no flowers and no border decoration.
vi: Tấm thiếp trơn tự hiện viền trang trí, cành hoa vẽ dần và nở trên thiếp.
en: Drawing animation from the first frame to the last: on the plain folded card the scalloped border draws itself around the edge, then the flower branches sketch themselves in ink, bloom and fill with soft colors, until the card matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a soft pen scratch and a gentle sparkle chime.

vi: Chú voi đá quả bóng, khỉ đạp xe vòng quanh, chú hề tung hứng; khán giả vỗ tay cười vui.
en: The elephant kicks the ball and it bounces, the monkey pedals the little bicycle around, the clown waves and juggles, the children in the audience clap and laugh, then everyone returns to the exact original picture. Sound: cheerful circus music, a bicycle bell, an elephant trumpet and children laughing (no words).

vi: Bóng đèn tắt rồi bật sáng rực, chao đèn đung đưa nhẹ, một con thiêu thân bay vòng quanh.
en: The light bulb flickers off and then switches on bright, its warm rays spreading out, the lamp shade sways gently on its cord, a little moth flutters around the light, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a light switch click and a soft electric hum.

vi: Tàu đánh cá rẽ sóng, cờ bay phần phật, hải âu lượn kêu, ngư dân vẫy tay.
en: The fishing boat ploughs through the waves throwing white spray, its flag snaps in the wind, the seagulls glide and call overhead, the fishermen wave, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a chugging boat engine, splashing waves and seagull cries.

vi: Ngựa gặm cỏ, ngẩng đầu hí, lắc bờm, vẫy đuôi, giậm chân rồi lại cúi ăn cỏ.
en: The horse munches the grass, lifts its head and neighs, shakes its mane, swishes its tail and stamps a hoof, then lowers its head to graze again in the exact original pose. Sound: a horse neighing, munching grass and a hoof stamp.

vi: Hộp diêm tự mở rộng ra, một que diêm quẹt bùng lửa nhỏ rồi tắt, khói mỏng bay lên, hộp đóng lại.
en: The matchbox drawer slides open a little more, one match lifts out and strikes the side, a small flame flares up and flickers, then it puffs out with a thin curl of smoke and the match settles back, ending in the exact original picture. Sound: a match strike scratch, a soft whoosh of flame and a little puff.

vi: Bé đặt thêm khối gỗ lên tháp, quả bóng lăn tới, bé cười vỗ tay, nơ tóc rung rinh.
en: The little girl places one more wooden block on her tower, the striped ball rolls toward her, she laughs and claps her hands, her hair ribbons bounce, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: wooden blocks clacking and a happy little giggle (no words).

vi: Đàn kiến nối đuôi nhau bò về tổ, khiêng chiếc lá và con châu chấu, râu ngọ nguậy.
en: The line of ants marches toward the anthill, carrying the leaf and the grasshopper together, their little legs and antennae wiggling busily, one ant goes into the hole and another comes out, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: tiny busy pitter-patter and rustling grass.

vi: Mưa gió quất mạnh, mây đen vần vũ, cò trắng vỗ cánh bay qua cánh đồng, lúa rạp theo gió.
en: Wind and rain sweep across the field, the dark clouds churn, the white stork beats its wings and glides through the rain, the rice plants and palm trees bend in the gusts, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: heavy rain, gusting wind, far thunder and wings flapping.

vi: Cánh diều chao lượn trong gió, đuôi diều uốn lượn, mây trôi, sáo diều vi vu.
en: The kite swoops and dips in the wind, its colorful tail ribbons ripple and curl, the string tugs, the clouds drift past, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: wind and a humming kite flute vi vu.

vi: Cô giáo cầm tay bé viết từng nét, bé ngẩng lên cười; các bạn chăm chú viết bài.
en: The teacher gently guides the boy's hand as he writes a stroke, he looks up and smiles at her, the other pupils keep writing carefully, the window leaves sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: pencils scratching on paper and soft birdsong outside.

vi: Mẹ ôm bé đung đưa ru nhẹ, bé dụi đầu vào mẹ cười, mẹ hôn lên tóc bé.
en: The mother hugs the baby and rocks gently from side to side, the baby snuggles into her and smiles, she kisses the baby's hair, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft humming lullaby (no words) and a baby's happy coo.

vi: Cậu bé chăm chú viết từng nét, ngẩng lên nhìn vở hài lòng, rồi viết tiếp.
en: The boy writes carefully in his notebook stroke by stroke, pauses to look at his work with a proud little smile, then bends down and keeps writing, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: a pen scratching on paper and a soft tick of a clock.

vi: Chim yểng ngoẹo đầu, há mỏ hót líu lo, xù lông, nhún nhảy trên cành.
en: The black hill myna tilts its head, opens its yellow beak and whistles a lively tune, fluffs its glossy feathers and bobs on the branch, the leaves tremble, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud cheerful myna whistle and chatter.

vi: Các bạn chụm đầu thì thầm rủ rê, cậu bé lắc đầu quay đi, đứng vững chống nạnh.
en: The group of children huddle and whisper, one beckons with a hand, the boy shakes his head firmly and turns his face away, standing tall with his hands on his hips, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: soft whispering murmurs (no words) and a firm little 'hmph'.

start: Keep the same paper background and style and the same green leaves at the bottom left, but remove both durians; instead, a thick brown branch enters from the top edge with a cluster of creamy white durian flowers hanging from it, and no fruit at all.
vi: Đúng như cây sầu riêng: chùm hoa trắng trên cành nở rồi rụng, quả non đầy gai nhú ra, lớn dần, gai dày lên; hai quả chín rụng xuống đất "bịch", một quả nứt theo múi lộ cơm vàng; cành rút lên khỏi khung.
en: Natural durian growth from the first frame to the last: the creamy white flowers hanging from the branch open and then fall, two small spiky green fruits form and swell into big heavy durians, their spikes growing thick and sharp; the two ripe durians drop down and land on the ground with a thud, one of them cracks open along its seams to reveal the creamy yellow pods, and the branch slides back up out of the frame, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The fruits only grow. Time only moves forward. Sound: a gentle growing sound, a heavy thud and a woody crack. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cậu bé kéo dây, cánh diều bay cao lượn vòng, đuôi diều tung bay, hàng cau đung đưa.
en: The boy tugs the string and the kite climbs higher and loops in the wind, its tail ribbons fluttering, he looks up with a big smile, the palm trees and grass sway, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: wind and a humming kite flute.

vi: Cánh buồm căng gió, thuyền nhấp nhô trên sóng, lá cờ bay phần phật, mây trôi.
en: The white sail fills and billows in the wind, the boat rises and dips on the waves, the little flag snaps at the top of the mast, the clouds drift, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: flapping canvas, splashing waves and wind.

vi: Cào cào nhảy tanh tách, ba bạn nhào tới chụp, cào cào nhảy thoát, các bạn cười vang.
en: The grasshoppers spring away in little hops, the three children lunge and cup their hands to catch them, the grasshoppers leap free, the children laugh, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: chirping grasshoppers, rustling grass and children's laughter (no words).

start: Keep the same paper background, banana leaf and style, but show only a hanging purple banana flower bud on its thick stem, no bananas yet.
vi: Bắp chuối hé ra, nải chuối xanh nhú lên, quả cong dài ra rồi chín vàng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the purple banana flower bud opens its petals, small green fingers of bananas appear in a hand, grow long and curved and ripen from green to bright yellow, until they match the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft growing sounds and rustling leaves.

start: Keep the same hoe (the same trapezoid iron blade with its round collar, fixed at a right angle to the long wooden handle), the same grass tufts, paper background and style, but the hoe is raised up in the air above the ground, its blade tilted up and back, and the ground under it is flat and smooth with no loose clods of earth.
vi: Cuốc đất: chiếc cuốc đang giơ cao bổ mạnh xuống, lưỡi cuốc cắm sâu vào đất, kéo nhẹ về làm đất vỡ ra thành những cục đất tơi văng bên cạnh, cỏ rung rinh; cuốc dừng lại cắm trong đất như tranh.
en: Hoeing animation from the first frame to the last: the raised hoe swings down in one strong arc, as if by an unseen farmer holding the far end of the handle, the iron blade bites deep into the ground with a thud, then pulls back a little so the earth breaks open into loose crumbly clods that tumble beside the blade, a few crumbs fly and the grass tufts tremble, until the hoe rests with its blade in the soil and everything matches the final illustration exactly. The blade always stays fixed at a right angle to the handle; The blade always stays rigid and at a right angle to the handle; the earth breaks only into small clods, and the clip ends with the handle lying horizontal exactly as in the picture. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward, never rewinds and never reverses. Sound: a whoosh, a solid thud of iron into soil and crumbling earth. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same children, ring, tree, paper background and style, but everyone stands still in the ring holding hands and smiling, and the two children in the middle stand upright facing each other, not running yet.
vi: Các bạn nắm tay đi vòng tròn, một bạn chạy vòng ngoài, một bạn luồn bên trong, ai cũng cười; dừng đúng tư thế tranh. Không đuôi, không tai, không hóa trang, không nhòe.
en: Playground animation from the first frame to the last: the children holding hands walk around in a ring, one boy runs around the outside of the ring and one girl runs through the inside, ducking under the joined hands, and everyone laughs, until they stop exactly in the poses of the final illustration. The children look exactly as in the picture: ordinary schoolchildren in their school clothes, each one sharp, solid and clearly drawn the whole time. Everyone stays fully inside the picture; nobody new appears. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: running footsteps and happy children's laughter. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Cô đạp máy tuốt lúa, trống quay vù vù, hạt thóc bay ra rổ; cô kia đưa bó lúa vào.
en: The woman pumps the pedal and the threshing drum spins, golden grains spray into the basket, the other woman feeds a sheaf of rice into the machine, straw bits fly, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a rhythmic whirring thresher and pattering grain.

vi: Chuông lắc nhẹ trên móc, quả lắc có sẵn gõ vào vành boong… boong, sóng âm lan ra rồi chuông đứng yên đúng tranh; không vật nào từ ngoài vào.
en: The bronze bell swings gently on its hook, only a little to each side, and the round clapper already hanging under it strikes the inside rim, 'boong… boong', faint circular sound ripples spreading out into the air, then the bell slows down and hangs still in the exact original picture. Nothing enters from outside the picture. The bell stays on its hook in the same place, one solid bell; the green wooden post stays still. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: one deep, resonant Vietnamese temple bell 'boong' ringing out and fading slowly, then a softer second ring. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Chuồn chuồn rung cánh, bay lên lượn trên mặt nước, chạm nước rồi đậu lại đúng ngọn cỏ.
en: The dragonfly flickers its wings, lifts off and darts over the water, dips and touches the surface making a small ripple, then flies back and lands exactly on the same grass blade in the original pose. Sound: a light dragonfly buzz and gentle water.

vi: Vịt gần như tại chỗ: nhích nhẹ, gật đầu, con trước vỗ cánh há mỏ kêu cạp cạp; hai con cá quẫy tại chỗ; luôn đúng 2 vịt, 2 cá.
en: The two ducks stay in about the same place on the pond: they paddle and drift only a tiny bit, nod their heads, the front duck flaps its wings once and opens its beak to quack happily, the two little fish flick their tails in place and blow a few bubbles, the lotus and reeds sway, then everything settles into the exact original picture. There are always exactly two ducks and exactly two fish; each one stays clearly separate and solid. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: cheerful real duck quacks 'quack quack', soft splashing and bubbles. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Mèo leo tiếp lên cây cau, vẫy đuôi; chú chuột đội nón xách giỏ chạy lon ton ra khỏi nhà.
en: The cat climbs a little higher up the areca trunk, flicks its tail and looks down, the little mouse in the conical hat trots off with its basket, swinging it happily, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: claws scratching bark, a soft meow and tiny pattering feet.

vi: Hươu sao vểnh tai, quay đầu, cúi ăn cỏ, vẫy đuôi rồi đứng lại như cũ.
en: The spotted deer twitches its ears, turns its head, bends down to nibble the grass, flicks its short tail, then lifts its head back into the exact original pose. Sound: rustling grass, a soft deer call and birdsong.

vi: Đàn hươu uống nước, gặm cỏ; suối chảy róc rách, chim đậu trên cành hót.
en: The deer dip their heads to drink from the stream and nibble the grass, one lifts its head and looks around, the stream flows and sparkles, the bird on the branch sings, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a babbling stream, a bird song and soft lapping.

start: Keep the same paper background, stalk, leaves and style, but show only a small white pomelo blossom on the stalk among the leaves, no fruit yet.
vi: Hoa bưởi trắng nở, quả bưởi nhỏ hiện ra, lớn tròn căng và chuyển vàng xanh.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the white pomelo blossom opens, its petals fall, a tiny green pomelo forms and swells into the big round fruit, turning yellow-green, until it matches the final illustration exactly; the leaves tremble. Sound: soft growing sounds and a light breeze.

start: Keep the same slide, tree, fence, paper background and style, but the boy sits at the very top of the slide holding the handrails, ready to go, and the girl is lower down on the ladder, climbing up.
vi: Cậu bé ngồi trên đỉnh cầu trượt buông tay trượt vèo xuống, giơ hai tay reo vui; bạn gái leo thang lên tới đỉnh, như tranh.
en: Sliding animation from the first frame to the last: the boy lets go of the handrails and whooshes down the slide, throwing both arms up and cheering, while the girl climbs up the ladder to the top, until they match the final illustration exactly with the boy halfway down the slide. The boy slides down only once and only halfway. The clip ends exactly at the moment in the picture, with the boy halfway down the slide. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward, never rewinds and never reverses. Sound: a whoosh down the slide and children's happy cheering. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the group of children: the whole group is just a few steps further back to the left along the same path inside the picture, every child almost the same size and fully inside the picture (nobody cut by the edge). Keep exactly the same children, lanterns, moon, trees, paper background and style.
vi: Đêm trung thu, các bạn rước đèn đi thật dọc đường từ trái sang tới chỗ trong tranh; đèn ông sao, đèn cá đung đưa, ánh nến lung linh, trăng sáng.
en: Lantern parade animation from the first frame to the last: the children walk forward to the right along the path in a joyful lantern parade, really travelling across the picture and never walking in place, everyone staying fully inside the picture (nobody enters through the side edges); the camera and background stay still, the star lantern and the fish lantern swing gently on their sticks, the candle lights flicker and glow and the full moon shines, until the children reach their positions and match the final illustration exactly. The lanterns keep exactly their shapes and frames (the star lantern keeps its round frame); only the candle light flickers inside; the scene keeps the same evening light. Time only moves forward. Sound: a festive mid-autumn drum, footsteps and children's laughter. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Ca nô lao trên mặt hồ, nước tung trắng, người trên ván lướt nhún người, rẽ sóng.
en: The speedboat races across the lake throwing white spray, the person on the water ski crouches and leans, carving through the wake, the rope tightens, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a buzzing outboard motor and rushing splashing water.

vi: Bướm vỗ cánh khép mở đều hai bên, thân thẳng, bay vòng nhỏ trong tranh rồi xoè cánh đúng như tranh; không xoay, không lộn, không nhoè.
en: The butterfly flaps its two wings evenly, opening and closing them together, its body staying straight, and flutters around in a small circle inside the picture, then settles back with its wings spread wide exactly as in the original picture. Its body stays straight and upright, its size stays the same and its wing pattern stays the same. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: soft wing flutters and a light breeze. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Mặt hồ gợn sóng, người đi dạo, xe đạp chạy qua, hoa phượng rơi; Tháp Rùa giữ nguyên.
en: Calm and gentle: the lake water ripples and sparkles, the strolling people walk along the path, the cyclist rides past, a few red flowers drift down from the tree, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The tower in the lake stays exactly as drawn. Sound: soft lapping water, a bicycle bell and birdsong.

start: Keep the same bamboo trellis, vine leaves, tendrils and style, but show only the yellow luffa flowers on the vine, no gourds yet.
vi: Hoa mướp vàng nở, quả mướp non thõng xuống, dài ra và căng mọng.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the yellow luffa flowers open, tiny green gourds appear beneath them, hang down and grow long and plump with their ridges, until they match the final illustration exactly; the tendrils curl. Sound: soft rustling growth and a light breeze.

vi: Vượn đánh đu trên cành, chuyền sang rồi đu lại, kêu hú, cành cây rung rinh.
en: The gibbon swings on the branch by one long arm, swings out and back, gives a playful call, the branch and leaves bounce, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a gibbon whooping call and rustling leaves.

vi: Bé chải tóc, nghiêng đầu cười với gương, bóng trong gương làm theo, rồi về như cũ.
en: The girl combs her hair with long strokes, tilts her head and smiles at the mirror, her reflection copies every move exactly, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft comb swish and a happy little hum (no words).

vi: Trăng tròn sáng dần, ánh trăng lấp lánh, rừng tre đung đưa, đèn lồng lắc nhẹ, khói trà bay lên.
en: The full moon glows brighter and its light shimmers over the stilt-house porch, the bamboo grove sways, the paper lantern swings gently, a thin wisp of steam rises from the teapot, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: night crickets, rustling bamboo and a soft breeze.

vi: Cậu bé hít một hơi rồi nói vào loa tiếng Việt rõ ràng "Loa! Loa! Loa!", mỗi tiếng có vạch âm thanh bật ra từ miệng loa.
en: The boy takes a breath and calls into the megaphone three times, clearly and cheerfully, the Vietnamese word "Loa! Loa! Loa!", his mouth shaping each word, short sound lines bursting out of the megaphone with each call, then he keeps the megaphone at his mouth in the exact original pose. He calls in a cheerful, clear voice. The megaphone stays held at his mouth the whole time; a burst of sound lines appears once with each call. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a boy's voice through a megaphone saying only the Vietnamese word "Loa! Loa! Loa!", with a light echo. No other words and no English.

vi: Chim chích choè hót líu lo, vẫy đuôi dài, nhún nhảy trên cành.
en: The magpie robin opens its beak and sings a rich melodious song, flicks its long tail up and down, bobs on the branch, the leaves tremble, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud sweet magpie robin song.

start: Keep the same children, tree, table, lamp, paper background and style, but the moon is completely hidden behind the cloud, and the hurricane lamp is unlit and dark.
vi: Đèn và trăng: ngọn lửa nhỏ trong bóng đèn bão từ từ sáng lên, cháy đều, chỉ lung linh trong bóng thuỷ tinh; mây trôi để lộ nửa vầng trăng; hai bạn chỉ tay nhìn đèn, nhìn trăng.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: inside the glass chimney of the hurricane lamp a small calm flame lights up and grows to a steady warm glow, flickering gently only inside the glass, while the cloud drifts slowly to the right and uncovers half of the bright moon, and the two children point and smile, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The flame stays a small, calm, candle-like flame inside the glass chimney. The moon stays a pale round moon; the two children keep pointing the whole time. Time only moves forward. Sound: night crickets and a soft hiss of the lamp. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Điện thoại bàn reo "reng reng": ống nghe rung nhẹ lên xuống trên giá theo từng hồi chuông, vạch âm thanh hiện ra; máy nằm yên một chỗ, không xoay, không quay.
en: The old telephone rings: with each ring the handset trembles in tiny quick jiggles up and down on its cradle and little ring lines appear around the bell, the curly cord quivers slightly, then the ringing stops and everything is still, ending in the exact original picture. The telephone body stays exactly in place: it stays still, and the dial stays still. The handset stays on its cradle the whole time; the ringing is heard all through the clip. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a loud, classic old telephone bell ringing 'ring ring, ring ring' several times. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Khoan tay quay đúng cách: cái khoan nằm yên, chỉ có tay quay cán cam quay vòng quanh trục thẳng của khoan, đầu kẹp quay theo cùng trục; mũi khoan xoắn nằm yên bên cạnh.
en: The hand brace drill turns the correct way: the whole drill stays in place, and only its crank, the bent metal bow with the orange wooden grip in the middle, sweeps around in a circle around the drill's straight central axis (the line from the round top knob to the chuck), while the chuck spins around that same axis; it makes two smooth turns and stops in the exact original position. The separate twist drill bit lies still. The drill and the bit lie still; only the crank turns. All metal parts stay rigid and straight; the orange grip and the round knob stay attached. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a smooth ratcheting whirr of a hand drill. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the mother and the girl: they are a few steps further back to the left along the same path inside the picture (almost the same size), still holding hands, the mother holding her basket. Keep exactly the same garden, house, pond, the woman washing at the pond, trees, paper background and style.
vi: Má dắt bé về quê ngoại, hai má con đi thật dọc đường tới chỗ trong tranh, tay đung đưa; người bên ao giũ áo nước bắn; xoài đung đưa, lá dừa lay.
en: Walking animation from the first frame to the last: the mother and the girl walk forward to the right hand in hand along the path, really travelling, the girl skipping a little, the basket swinging, while the woman by the pond shakes out the washing with a splash, the ripe mangoes sway on the tree and the coconut fronds wave, until they reach their positions and match the final illustration exactly. The mother holds her basket the whole time; the woman at the pond stays in her place and only shakes out the cloth, with water splashing only near her hands. Time only moves forward. Sound: footsteps, splashing water, birdsong and a rooster far away. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same calf, bamboo, bird, house, paper background and style, but the calf is a little further to the left with its head lowered to the grass, and the white egret is further to the left in the sky.
vi: Chú nghé con bước tới, ngẩng đầu vểnh tai nghe chim hót rồi kêu "nghé ọ" bằng giọng nghé con non nớt; cò trắng bay ngang qua tới chỗ trong tranh.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the little buffalo calf takes a few steps forward to the right, lifts its head and pricks up its ears toward the singing bird, then gives a soft, high-pitched baby calf call, the white egret flies across the sky to the right, until everything matches the final illustration exactly. The egret only glides in a small circle inside the sky of the picture. Time only moves forward. Sound: the thin, high, gentle voice of a very young calf (a baby calf), cheerful birdsong and rustling bamboo. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Mưa rơi lộp độp, hai bạn nhảy vào vũng nước té nước, giơ tay hứng mưa, cười vui.
en: Rain pours down, the two children in raincoats hop into the puddles making splashes, the girl holds out her hand to catch the drops, they laugh, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: rain pattering on raincoats, puddle splashes and happy giggles (no words).

vi: Bạn đứng phát biểu, vẫy tay; các bạn quay sang lắng nghe, gật đầu, một bạn ghi chép.
en: A friendly class group meeting: the standing pupil waves his hand cheerfully, the classmates around the table turn toward him, smile and nod, one girl writes in her notebook, the flowers in the pot sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft pencil scratch, a light breeze and happy murmurs (no words).

start: Change ONLY the boy: the same boy stands a few steps further back to the left on the same road inside the picture (near the tree, almost the same size), in a walking pose. Keep exactly the same road, trees, hills, village, clouds, paper background and style.
vi: Chú bé loắt choắt chân bước thoăn thoắt, đi thật dọc đường đồi từ trái tới chỗ trong tranh, cái xắc nảy theo bước chân.
en: Walking animation from the first frame to the last: the little boy strides briskly forward to the right along the hill road with quick, light steps, his satchel bouncing at his side and his arms swinging, really travelling along the road, until he reaches his position and matches the final illustration exactly; the grass sways and the clouds drift. The sky and the clouds stay the same. Time only moves forward. Sound: quick light footsteps and a breeze over the hills. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same mountain road, cliffs, trees, posts, paper background and style, and add one small old green bus on the road right at the bottom edge of the picture, where the road runs out of the picture, driving up the road.
vi: Một chiếc xe khách nhỏ chạy chậm đúng theo con đường quanh co, đi lên chỗ ngoặt gấp rồi khuất sau vách núi; xe luôn ở trên mặt đường.
en: Driving animation from the first frame to the last: the small green bus drives slowly and carefully along the winding road, following every curve of the road exactly, staying on the road surface the whole time, it slows down at the sharp bend, turns with the road and disappears behind the rocky cliff, until the road is empty and matches the final illustration exactly. The bus stays on the road surface. There is only this one bus; it drives one way only, getting smaller as it goes further. Time only moves forward. Sound: a low engine hum and one short horn beep at the bend. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bé lắc đầu, mái tóc xoăn tít nảy tưng tưng, nơ rung rinh, bé cười tươi.
en: The little girl shakes her head and her tight curls bounce like springs, her hair bow wiggles, she blinks and gives a big smile, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful little giggle (no words).

vi: Các bạn đặt thêm giấy vụn, lon sắt vào đống, đống giấy cao dần, bạn nhỏ phủi tay vui vẻ.
en: The children add more bundles of paper and tin cans to the pile, the pile grows a little taller, one girl brushes her hands and smiles, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: rustling paper and clinking cans.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only one whole long uncut loaf of bread, no slices.
vi: Ổ bánh mì nguyên tự cắt thành từng khoanh, vụn bánh rơi, các khoanh ngả ra lộ ruột.
en: Slicing animation from the first frame to the last: an invisible knife cuts the whole loaf, the round slices fall away one by one and tip over to show the soft crumb, a few crumbs scatter, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a crunchy bread knife sawing and soft crumbs falling.

vi: Cô nông dân vác bó lúa, người khẽ đung đưa, miệng hát dịu dàng một làn điệu dân ca tiếng Việt; đồng lúa vàng gợn sóng, khăn bay nhẹ.
en: The farmer girl carrying the sheaf of rice sways gently and sings softly with a happy smile, her lips moving with the song, the end of her towel flutters, the golden rice field ripples in the wind and the haystacks rustle, ending in the exact original pose. She always faces forward and stays in her place. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a young Vietnamese woman softly singing a gentle, sweet Vietnamese folk melody (Vietnamese lyrics only, never English), with rustling rice stalks.

vi: Con hoẵng nhảy vọt qua bụi cỏ, đáp xuống rồi lại vọt lên đúng tư thế cũ.
en: The barking deer lands from its leap, takes two springy bounds through the bushes and leaps again, ending in the exact original mid-jump pose, the grass waving behind it. Sound: light hoof thuds and rustling bushes.

vi: Hai người khai hoang vừa làm vừa hát: người đàn ông bổ cuốc xới đất, người phụ nữ phát cỏ, cả hai cùng hò một câu hò lao động tiếng Việt vui khoẻ.
en: The two farmers work and sing together: the man swings his hoe up and brings it down, turning over a clod of earth, the woman cuts a tuft of tall grass with her knife and it falls away, both of them singing a cheerful, strong Vietnamese work song in rhythm with their work, then they continue into the exact original pose. The man raises his hoe straight up in front of himself and chops down into the ground right in front of his feet; the woman cuts grass on her own side; both tools keep their shapes. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a man and a woman singing a lively Vietnamese work chant together (Vietnamese words only, never English), hoe thuds and swishing grass.

vi: Hai người khiêng thúng cá bước đi, cá quẫy lấp lánh, người trên thuyền chuyển cá, sóng vỗ.
en: The two fishermen carry the basket of fish a few steps, the silvery fish flip and sparkle, the man on the boat lifts more fish, small waves lap the shore, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: waves, flapping fish and seagulls.

vi: Lá cờ lớn bay phần phật, đoàn quân xa xa phi ngựa, bụi bốc lên; nhìn từ xa, không rõ mặt.
en: The big banner flaps strongly in the wind, the distant cavalry gallops forward with flags streaming and a trail of dust, seen far away with no clear faces, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: galloping hooves, a snapping flag and a war drum in the distance.

start: Keep the same paper background and style and the same long green leaves at the bottom, but only the long green leaves are there.
vi: Cây huệ trổ hoa: từ giữa khóm lá, cành hoa vươn thẳng lên, đầu cành nhú nụ, các nụ dài ra rồi lần lượt nở thành bông huệ trắng, nhụy hiện ra như tranh.
en: Natural blooming from the first frame to the last: from the middle of the leaves a green flower stalk shoots straight up and branches, slender buds appear at its tips and grow long, then the buds open one after another into white star-shaped flowers, petals curling back and orange stamens appearing, while the top buds stay closed, until the plant matches the final illustration exactly. Flowers only grow from the stalk and only open. Only one stalk grows, with exactly as many long buds as in the picture; each bud opens into exactly one flower. Time only moves forward. Sound: a gentle growing sound and a soft sparkle. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Tàu thuỷ chạy trên sông, ống khói nhả khói, kéo còi, sóng rẽ hai bên.
en: The steamship chugs along the river, puffs of smoke billow from its funnel, it sounds its horn, waves roll from its bow, then it settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a chugging engine and a deep ship horn 'tuu'.

vi: Thuyền buồm trôi trên sông, nước gợn, mây trôi, lá cây đung đưa; công trình giữ nguyên.
en: Calm and gentle: the sailboats glide slowly down the river, the water ripples and sparkles, the clouds drift, the tree leaves sway and a few red flowers fall, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The buildings stay exactly as drawn. Sound: soft lapping water and birdsong.

vi: Tấm huân chương đung đưa nhẹ trên dải băng, một vệt sáng lấp lánh lướt qua ngôi sao.
en: The star medal swings gently on its ribbon, a bright gleam of light slides across the golden star with a sparkle, then it settles back into the exact original position. Sound: a soft metallic chime.

vi: Bạn trai xúc đất vun gốc, bạn gái giữ cây non thẳng, cây non vươn lá, các bạn phía xa trồng cây.
en: The boy shovels soil around the young tree, the girl holds it straight, the sapling sprouts a new leaf, the other children in the distance plant their trees, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: shovel scrapes, birdsong and children's happy chatter (no words).

vi: Vòi voi đang buông thõng từ từ cong mềm vươn lên cao tới đúng dáng tranh, voi há miệng rống tiếng voi thật; tai vẫy.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the elephant flaps its ears and slowly raises its trunk, the trunk curling softly and naturally upward, and opens its mouth to trumpet, until the trunk is held high exactly as in the final illustration; the trunk keeps its natural length and gentle curves and stops at the pose in the picture. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a real wild elephant trumpeting call recorded in nature. No speech, no words, no English.
start: Change ONLY the elephant's trunk: it hangs down relaxed in front, curving softly near the ground, mouth closed. Keep exactly the same elephant body, ears, tusks, grass, paper background and style.

vi: Bếp lửa bập bùng, nồi bốc hơi, cả nhà quây quần cười nói, mặt trời lặn dần.
en: The fire crackles and its warm flames dance, steam rises from the pot, the family leans in and smiles together, the sun sinks a little behind the mountains, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a crackling fire, a bubbling pot and soft family murmurs (no words).

vi: Hai con cá vàng ngoe nguẩy đuôi, bơi vòng quanh bể, nhả bong bóng, rong lay động.
en: The two goldfish swish their fan tails and swim a circle around the round bowl, little bubbles float up, the water plants sway, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: gentle bubbling water.

vi: Máy tiện quay, phoi kim loại xoắn ra, người thợ xoay tay quay, đèn sáng.
en: The lathe spins, curly metal shavings peel off the turning part, the worker turns the handwheel carefully, the lamp glows, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a humming lathe motor and a soft metal whirr.

vi: Chim vành khuyên hót ríu rít, nghiêng đầu, nhảy nhẹ trên cành; hoa trắng rung rinh.
en: The little white-eye tilts its head, chirps a quick sweet song and hops along the branch, the white blossoms tremble, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: high sweet twittering of a white-eye.

vi: Đoàn chiến sĩ bước đều tăm tắp, tay vung đều, lá cờ bay; trang nghiêm.
en: The soldiers march forward in perfect step, arms swinging in unison, the flag waves above them, then they return to the exact original pose. Calm and dignified. Sound: crisp rhythmic marching boots and a snapping flag.

vi: Thuyền buồm trôi giữa các đảo đá, nước gợn sóng, mây trôi, chim bay xa.
en: The junk with orange sails glides slowly between the limestone islands, the water ripples and sparkles, the clouds drift and a few birds fly far away, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft waves and a gentle sea breeze.

vi: Thuyền nhỏ trôi trên sông, đồi chè gợn gió, rừng cọ đung đưa, mây trôi trên núi.
en: The little boat drifts along the river with ripples behind it, the tea hills ripple in the breeze, the palm trees sway, clouds drift over the mountains, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: flowing water, a breeze and birdsong.

vi: Các bạn thiếu nhi cười nói vui vẻ, khăn quàng bay nhẹ, hoa trong chậu rung rinh.
en: The children laugh and lean toward each other happily, their red scarves flutter gently, the flowers in the pot sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: happy children's laughter (no words) and birdsong.

vi: Quả địa cầu xoay tròn, các bạn giơ tay reo vui, chim bồ câu vỗ cánh bay, bóng bay bồng bềnh.
en: The globe spins around, the children wave their arms and cheer, the white doves flap and circle overhead, the balloons bob, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: children cheering (no words), flapping wings and a cheerful chime.

vi: Cờ bay phần phật, các bạn bước vào cổng trường, cây xanh lay động.
en: The flag flutters on the pole, the pupils walk through the school gate with their bags, the trees sway in the breeze, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, a school bell and birdsong.

vi: Bé giơ sách mới khoe bà, bà cúi xuống cười; mẹ sàng gạo, hạt gạo nhảy trên nong.
en: The girl holds up her new book proudly, the grandmother leans down and smiles, the mother shakes the winnowing tray and the rice grains bounce, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: rustling rice grains, a soft happy laugh and chickens clucking.

vi: Nước chảy từ vòi, bé xoa tay đầy bọt xà phòng, bong bóng bay lên, hoa trên giàn rung rinh.
en: Water runs from the tap, the girl rubs her soapy hands together, bubbles float up and pop, she rinses and smiles, the flowers above sway, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: running water, splashing and popping bubbles.

vi: Chú chim cầm sách đọc to, hai bạn chim nghe, gật gù hót theo.
en: The little bird with the book chirps out loud as if reading, the two other chicks nod along and chirp back, flapping their tiny wings, the leaves sway, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: rhythmic cheerful chick chirping.

vi: Các bạn giơ vở mới lên khoe, cười vui, nhún nhảy nhẹ.
en: The children lift their new notebooks up proudly, laugh and bounce a little on their toes, the flowers sway, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: happy children's laughter (no words) and rustling paper.

vi: Tán bàng xào xạc, lá rơi, các bạn đá bóng, bóng lăn; mấy bạn ngồi dưới gốc trò chuyện.
en: The big tree's leaves rustle and a few drift down, the children kick the ball and it rolls, the group under the tree chats and laughs, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: rustling leaves, a ball kick and children playing (no words).

vi: Đàn thỏ nắm tay múa vòng tròn, hươu gật gù xem, sóc nhún nhảy, trăng sáng.
en: The rabbits hold hands and dance around in a circle, hopping on the beat, the deer nod along, the squirrel bounces on its branch, the moon glows, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful forest dance tune with light drum taps and crickets.

vi: Bốn bạn tung tăng đi học, túi sách nảy, tre đung đưa, trống trường xa xa.
en: The four children walk happily along the village road, their bags bouncing, they chat and laugh, the bamboo sways, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, chatter-like laughter (no words) and a school drum far away.

vi: Hai con dê lùi lại rồi húc đầu vào nhau, kêu be be, cầu rung, suối chảy.
en: The black goat and the white goat step back and butt heads together, bleating stubbornly, the narrow bridge wobbles, the stream rushes below, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: goats bleating 'be be', a horn clack and a rushing stream.

start: Change ONLY the jar and pebbles: the water in the jar is low, about one third of the jar, with only a few pebbles inside, more pebbles on the ground by the stump, and the crow's beak is closed with no pebble in the air. Keep exactly the same crow, stump, jar shape, branch, paper background and style.
vi: Quạ uống nước: quạ nhặt từng hòn sỏi thả vào lọ, mỗi hòn rơi "tõm" thì nước dâng cao thêm, sỏi đọng dưới đáy, đến khi nước lên cao như tranh.
en: The thirsty crow animation from the first frame to the last: the crow picks up pebbles from the ground one by one and drops them into the jar; with every plop the pebbles settle at the bottom and the water level clearly rises higher, until the water is high in the jar and the crow is dropping one more pebble, matching the final illustration exactly. The water only rises. The crow does this twice: it pecks up one pebble from the pile by the stump and drops it into the jar with a plop; each time the water rises one clear step, the pebbles in the jar increase by one and the pebbles on the ground decrease by one; the clip ends at the moment the pebble falls from its beak, as in the picture. Time only moves forward. Sound: pebble plops into water and a crow's caw. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show the same wooden pencil with a flat, unsharpened end, no point.
vi: Cây bút chì tự vót nhọn, vỏ gỗ cuộn ra, ruột chì đen lộ ra thành đầu nhọn.
en: Sharpening animation from the first frame to the last: the flat end of the pencil is shaved by an invisible blade, curly wood shavings spin off, the black lead appears and becomes a sharp point, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a crisp sharpening scrape.

vi: Cục tẩy tự chà qua lại, vụn tẩy rơi, vết bẩn mờ đi rồi tẩy về chỗ cũ.
en: The eraser rubs back and forth on the paper by itself, little eraser crumbs roll off and a pencil smudge fades away, then it returns to the exact original position. Sound: soft rubbing squeaks.

start: Keep the same wooden ruler shape, color, wood grain, paper background and style, but the ruler is a plain smooth strip of wood.
vi: Làm cây thước: trên thanh gỗ trơn, các vạch chia lần lượt được khắc từ trái sang phải, cứ năm vạch có một vạch dài, đến khi thành cây thước như tranh.
en: Ruler-making animation from the first frame to the last: along the edge of the plain wooden strip the tick marks are etched one by one from the left end to the right end, as if by an invisible fine pencil, every fifth mark a little longer, until the ruler matches the final illustration exactly. The ruler lies completely still at exactly the angle of the picture the whole time; only the marks appear, one small tick sound each. Time only moves forward. Sound: quick tiny scratching ticks. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Hai bạn nghiêng đầu đố nhau, dấu hỏi nảy lên, bạn gái hé lộ món đồ rồi giấu lại.
en: The two children tilt their heads and grin at each other, the question marks above them bounce, the girl peeks her hidden object out from behind her back and hides it again, then they return to the exact original pose. Sound: a playful 'hmm' giggle (no words) and a boing for the question marks.

vi: Mẹ phe phẩy quạt, em bé ngủ ngon, chị đọc sách lật trang, mèo vẫy đuôi.
en: The mother fans gently with the paper fan, the baby sleeps peacefully and stirs a little, the sister turns a page of her book, the cat flicks its tail, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a soft fan whoosh, a page turn and a sleepy purr.

vi: Chị đưa võng, võng đong đưa, em bé ngủ say, chó nằm thở đều, lá rơi.
en: The girl rocks the hammock and it swings gently back and forth, the baby sleeps soundly, the dog breathes slowly in its sleep, a leaf drifts down, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a creaking hammock rope, a soft lullaby hum (no words) and birdsong.

start: Keep the same house, door, flowers, paper background and style; the postman has just stopped his bicycle at the gate inside the picture and stands beside it, and the boy stands in the doorway holding the glass of water against his chest.
vi: Bác đưa thư vừa dừng xe ở cổng, dựng xe, bấm chuông; bé bước ra đưa cốc nước; cốc chỉ đi một chiều; kết thúc đúng lúc tay bác vừa chạm cốc như tranh.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the postman puts the kickstand down and rings the bicycle bell twice, the boy steps out and holds the glass of water out with both hands, and the postman smiles and reaches out, the clip ending exactly when his hand touches the glass, as in the final illustration. The glass goes one way only, from the boy toward the postman. Everyone stays fully inside the picture. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a bicycle kickstand clack, a bright bell 'ring ring' and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Change ONLY the mother and the girl: they are a few steps further back along the same path inside the picture (near the fence, almost the same size), walking. Keep exactly the same rain, house, fence, carrying pole and baskets, paper background and style.
vi: Trời mưa to, mẹ đội nón đi chợ về, bé quẩy gánh chạy theo đỡ mẹ; hai mẹ con đi thật tới chỗ trong tranh, nước vũng bắn lên. Không có lời nói.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: in the heavy rain the mother and her daughter hurry forward to the right along the muddy path, really travelling, never walking in place, the carrying pole and baskets bouncing on the girl's shoulder, water splashing from the puddles at each step, until they reach their positions and match the final illustration exactly. The rain falls evenly all through the clip. Time only moves forward. Sound: heavy rain, splashing footsteps and a creaking carrying pole. No speech, no words, no English at all.

vi: Chuột béo giãy giụa trong khe vách, chuột kia hốt hoảng nhảy lên, vụn vữa rơi.
en: The fat mouse wriggles and kicks, stuck in the crack in the wall, the other mouse hops up and down in alarm waving its arms, a few bits of plaster fall, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: frantic squeaks and crumbling plaster.

vi: Bà phe phẩy quạt mỉm cười nghe; bé đọc truyện bằng tiếng Việt "Ngày xửa ngày xưa..." rồi lật trang; mẹ khâu áo kéo sợi chỉ.
en: The grandmother fans herself slowly and smiles as she listens, the girl reads aloud from her book and then turns a page, the mother pulls her needle and thread through the cloth, ending in the exact original pose. The girl turns the page exactly once; the fan keeps its shape. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a little girl's voice reading in Vietnamese only, saying "Ngày xửa ngày xưa..." softly, a soft fan whoosh, a page turn and birdsong. No English at all.

vi: Bé nặn đất thành con chuột, nặn xong đặt xuống nong; mèo vểnh tai, vẫy đuôi tò mò.
en: The child squeezes and shapes the clay in his hands into a little mouse and sets it on the tray, the cat perks up its ears and flicks its tail curiously, then everything returns to the exact original pose. Sound: soft squishy clay and a curious meow.

vi: Hai anh em vẫy tay chào, bố mẹ ở cửa sổ vẫy lại, cây lay động.
en: The two children wave goodbye as they set off, the parents at the window wave back and smile, the trees and flowers sway, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps, birdsong and a happy farewell call (no words).

start: Change ONLY the girl: she stands one step further back to the right, holding the bowl of water against her chest. Keep exactly the same mother, bamboo bed, house, basket, the boy fanning, paper background and style.
vi: Bé trai quạt đều suốt clip, mẹ lau mồ hôi, bé gái bước tới mời bát nước; kết thúc đúng lúc như tranh; mẹ chưa cầm bát, nước không đổ.
en: Animation from the first frame to the last: the boy fans his mother steadily all through the clip, the breeze lifting her hair, the mother wipes the sweat from her face with her towel and smiles, and the girl steps forward and holds the bowl of water out toward her mother, the clip ending exactly at that moment, as in the final illustration; the bowl stays in the girl's hands, its water calm. Time only moves forward: no jump, no rewind. Sound: a soft fan whoosh, a tired happy sigh and birdsong. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bé cúi ngửi bông hồng, bông hồng hé nở rộng hơn, bé mỉm cười, lá rung rinh.
en: The girl leans in to smell the red rose, the rose opens a little wider, she smiles happily, the leaves sway in the breeze, then she returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a gentle sniff, a happy sigh and birdsong.

vi: Ong mật vo ve bay quanh cành đào, đậu vào bông hoa hút mật rồi bay lên.
en: The honeybee buzzes around the peach blossoms, lands on a flower, sips the nectar, then lifts off and hovers back to the exact original position. Sound: a lively bee buzz.

vi: Trâu gặm cỏ, ngẩng đầu nghé ọ, vẫy đuôi, lắc sừng rồi cúi ăn tiếp.
en: The water buffalo munches the grass, raises its head and lows, swishes its tail and shakes its horns, then lowers its head to graze again in the exact original pose. Sound: a deep buffalo low 'nghé ọ' and munching grass.

vi: Gà trống vươn cổ gáy ò ó o, vỗ cánh phành phạch trên đống rơm.
en: The rooster stretches its neck and crows loudly, flaps its wings hard on top of the straw pile, a few straws fly, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a loud rooster crow 'ò ó o' and flapping wings.

vi: Hai bạn hái sim bỏ vào giỏ, con diều bay lượn trên cao, đàn trâu gặm cỏ vẫy đuôi, mặt trời chiều toả nắng.
en: Summer on the hill: the two children pick ripe purple sim berries and drop them into the basket, the kite dances and swoops in the sky as the boy tugs the string, the buffaloes graze and swish their tails, the bushes sway, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a summer breeze, a fluttering kite, cicadas and a buffalo low far away.

vi: Đàn sơn ca vỗ cánh bay vút lên, lượn vòng trên trời, hoa cỏ trên đồi đung đưa, mây trôi.
en: The flock of skylarks beat their wings and soar upward, circle and glide across the sky, the grass and little orange flowers on the hillside sway in the wind, the clouds drift, then the birds return to their exact original positions. Sound: bright, joyful skylark songs and a soft wind over the hill.

vi: Người chèo thuyền chở lúa đi trên sông, nước lăn tăn, hàng dừa đung đưa, đồng lúa gợn sóng, khói bếp bay lên.
en: The boatman rows the boat loaded with rice sheaves along the winding river, ripples spread on the water, the coconut palms sway, the golden rice field ripples like waves in the wind, a thin wisp of kitchen smoke rises from the village house, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: an oar splashing, flowing water, birdsong and a breeze through the rice.

vi: Giọt nước trên lá khoai lăn xuống tách tách, gà mẹ cục cục gọi con, đàn gà con chạy lon ton mổ quanh vũng nước.
en: After the rain: water drops roll off the big taro leaves and fall with tiny plips into the puddle making little rings, the mother hen clucks and scratches the ground, the yellow chicks run around the puddle and peck, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: dripping water, a mother hen clucking and chicks peeping.

vi: Con gấu cúi ngửi mặt người nằm, người ấy nín thở nằm im; người trên cây bám chặt nhìn xuống; gấu lắc đầu bỏ đi rồi quay lại chỗ cũ.
