en: The black bear sniffs the face of the man lying still on the ground, the man holds his breath and does not move, the boy up in the tree clings to the branch and peeks down, the two friends watch with worried faces, the bear shakes its head and turns away, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a bear's snuffling and a low grunt, rustling leaves and forest birds (no words).

vi: Hai chú thợ vặn ốc sửa xe tải, máy tiện quay, máy nén khí rung; các bạn chỉ trỏ, ngó nghiêng thích thú.
en: In the busy repair workshop: the two mechanics tighten bolts on the open truck engine, the lathe spins, the air compressor shudders, the lamps sway slightly, the guide points and the pupils lean forward and point with excitement, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: clinking wrenches, a humming machine and a compressor hiss (no words).

vi: Voi giơ vòi rống, tê giác lắc đầu, trâu rừng thở phì, nai ngẩng lên nghe ngóng, gấu đen lững thững bước; cây cỏ rung rinh.
en: In the Central Highlands forest: the elephant raises its trunk and trumpets, the rhinoceros shakes its head, the wild buffalo snorts and swings its horns, the deer lift their heads and twitch their ears, the black bear ambles a few steps, the tall grass and leaves sway, then all the animals return to their exact original poses. Sound: an elephant trumpet, a buffalo snort, rustling grass and jungle birds.

vi: Nước từ ống tre chảy ào xuống máng gỗ, mặt nước sóng sánh; các bạn nhỏ cười, vẫy tay, một bạn vốc nước té lên.
en: Water pours from the bamboo pipe into the wooden trough, the water surface splashes and ripples, the stream flows past the rocks, the children laugh, one dips a hand and splashes a little water, another waves the towel, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: pouring and splashing water, a rushing mountain stream and children's laughter (no words).

vi: Chim sâu nghiêng đầu, mổ con sâu xanh, nhảy nhẹ trên cành; lá rung rinh trong gió.
en: The little warbler tilts its head, pecks at the green caterpillar on the branch, hops a step along the branch and flicks its tail, the green leaves tremble in the breeze, then it returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a cheerful little chirp, a tiny peck and rustling leaves.

vi: Trăng tròn sáng dịu, mây mỏng trôi qua; hai bạn ngước nhìn trăng, tàu chuối và hàng cau đung đưa, bóng lá lay động trên sân.
en: On the moonlit night: the full moon glows softly and a thin cloud drifts past it, the two children gaze up at the moon and the girl smiles, the banana leaves and areca palms sway gently, their shadows move on the yard, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: crickets, a soft night breeze and rustling banana leaves.

vi: Cái xẻng tự xúc một nhát đất, hất đất lên rồi cắm lại vào đống đất như cũ.
en: The shovel comes alive: it pulls itself out of the soil mound, scoops up a load of earth, tosses it in a little arc, then digs back into the mound and stands in the exact original position. Sound: a metal blade crunching into soil and falling dirt.

vi: Chị giơ ngón tay ra câu đố, em chống cằm suy nghĩ, đảo mắt rồi mỉm cười; cửa sổ và cánh cửa đứng yên hoàn toàn, chỉ lá cây ngoài cửa khẽ lay; kết thúc đúng dáng tranh, ngón tay chị giơ lên.
en: The older sister keeps her finger raised and asks a riddle with a playful smile, moving her lips silently, while the younger girl rests her chin on her hand, looks up and to the side thinking, then breaks into a bright smile; the clip ends exactly in the original pose with the sister's finger raised. The window frame and the wooden shutters stay completely still and rigid; only the leaves outside the window sway gently. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: soft birdsong outside and a little 'hmm'. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, but show only the single bottom-right brick lying on the paper, with no other bricks.
vi: Từng viên gạch đỏ trượt vào, xếp chồng lên nhau cạch cạch cho đến khi thành chồng gạch như tranh.
en: Stacking animation from the first frame to the last: one red brick after another slides in from the side and settles into place with a solid clack, building up the stack layer by layer until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: heavy brick clacks and a little dust puff.

vi: Cày gỗ nằm yên trên ruộng, không tự chạy; vòng dây thừng ở đầu cày đung đưa, vài cục đất khô rơi khỏi lưỡi cày, cỏ lay trong gió.
en: The wooden plough lies still on the field (it is a simple wooden hand tool): only the loop of rope at its front end swings gently, a few small crumbs of dry soil fall from the shiny iron blade, and the grass tufts sway in the breeze, ending in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a soft breeze, crumbs of soil falling and birdsong far away. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Chú thợ mỏ dắt tay cháu, chỉ về phía goòng than, mỉm cười; cháu ngước nhìn; đèn mũ và đèn hầm chỉ sáng dịu một quầng nhỏ; goòng than đứng yên trên ray.
en: The miner holds the boy's hand and points toward the coal carts with a warm smile, the boy looks up at him with wide curious eyes and nods; the lamp on the miner's helmet and the tunnel lamps glow softly, each with only a small gentle halo; the coal carts stay still on the rails; ending in the exact original pose. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a faint echo in the tunnel, soft footsteps and a distant drip. No speech, no voice, no words, no English.

vi: Cua bò ngang ra khỏi hang rồi giơ càng; cá rô phi nhảy lên một lần, rơi "tõm"; trâu chỉ chớp mắt, vẫy tai, nhai, cười, không có tay chân người; bác nông dân và máy cày tay phía xa chạy chậm.
en: On the field bank: the two crabs scuttle sideways a little out of their hole and raise their claws, the tilapia leaps up once and drops back into the water with a splash, always keeping its fish shape; the buffalo only blinks, flicks its ears, chews and smiles; it looks exactly as in the picture; far away the farmer walks slowly behind the small hand tractor; ending in the exact original picture. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward or rewinds. Sound: a fish splash, clicking crab claws, a contented buffalo low and a small engine far away. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same river, coconut palms, houses, sailing boat, clouds and style, but it is just before sunrise: the sun is still hidden below the horizon with only a soft pale glow there, and no sun rays on the water.
vi: Mặt trời từ từ nhô lên ở chân trời, tia nắng toả ra, mặt sông lấp lánh, thuyền buồm trôi nhẹ, hàng dừa đung đưa.
en: Sunrise animation from the first frame to the last: the sun slowly rises above the horizon, its rays spread out and the river begins to shimmer with golden reflections, the sailing boat drifts gently, the coconut palms sway, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: soft morning birdsong, gentle lapping water and a rooster crowing far away.

vi: Sóng biển nhẹ nhàng xô vào bờ cát rồi rút ra, hàng dương reo trong gió, bông hoa trắng khẽ rung; yên bình, trang nghiêm.
en: Calm and peaceful: gentle waves roll up onto the sandy shore and slide back, the casuarina trees sway and whisper in the sea breeze, the white flower under the tree trembles softly, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: soft waves, the whistling of the casuarina trees in the wind, no music.

vi: Bác nông dân chỉ tay về phía gấu; con gấu đen to lớn khịt mũi, gật gù; lá củ cải rung rinh, cây rừng đung đưa.
en: The farmer points toward the forest and leans on his hoe, the big black bear sniffs the air, nods its head and shifts its weight, the radish leaves rustle, the forest trees sway, then both return to the exact original pose. Sound: a bear's grunt and snuffle, rustling leaves and forest birds (no words).

vi: Cô giáo vẫy tay chào, các bạn giơ tay reo, mũ tung lên cao rồi rơi xuống; cửa sổ nắng sáng.
en: Goodbye to grade one: the teacher waves and smiles warmly, the pupils raise their arms and cheer, the caps fly up into the air, spin and fall back down, the sunlight through the window brightens, then everyone returns to the exact original pose. Sound: happy children cheering (no words), clapping and a school bell.

start: Keep the same paper background and style, and the same square tin box, but with its decorated lid closed on top, so no biscuits are visible.
vi: Nắp hộp bánh từ từ mở ra, nghiêng sang bên, lộ ra những chiếc bánh quy vàng thơm.
en: Opening animation from the first frame to the last: the lid of the tin box lifts up with a little pop, tilts and settles beside the box, revealing the golden round biscuits inside, a few tiny sparkles twinkle, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: a metal tin lid pop, a soft clink and a happy little chime.

start: Keep the same paper background, the same leaf and stem and the same style, but remove both limes; instead, the same short stem holds the leaf and two small white five-petal lime blossoms, with no fruit at all.
vi: Đúng như cây chanh: hai bông chanh trắng nở, cánh rụng, mỗi bông đậu đúng một quả non (không thành chùm), quả lớn dần thành quả chanh xanh; một quả tách đôi lộ múi chanh. Lá giữ nguyên suốt clip; khung cuối đúng tranh.
en: Natural lime growth from the first frame to the last: the two white lime blossoms on the stem open, their petals drop, and each blossom sets exactly ONE tiny green lime (two fruits in total), each tiny lime swells into a big glossy green lime; then the front lime splits cleanly in half with a juicy pop, its half turning face up to show the pale juicy segments, a few drops of juice sparkle, until it matches the final illustration exactly: one whole lime with its stem and leaf, and one lime half. The green leaf stays attached and fully visible the whole time. The fruit only grows. Time only moves forward. Sound: a soft growing sound, a juicy pop and a tiny drip. No speech, no words, no English.

start: Keep the same school bag, books, notebook, paper background and style, but the bag lies tipped over on its side with its flap open, and the two books and the notebook are scattered messily around it.
vi: Cặp sách tự dọn gọn: cặp đứng dậy, nắp gập xuống, khoá cài tách tách; hai quyển sách nhảy lên xếp thành chồng, quyển vở trượt về nằm ngay ngắn.
en: Tidying animation from the first frame to the last: the tipped-over school bag stands itself upright, its flap folds down and the two buckles click shut one after the other, the two scattered books hop up and stack themselves neatly, and the notebook slides over and lies straight, until everything matches the final illustration exactly. Time only moves forward. Sound: two buckle clicks, soft book thumps and a paper slide. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Con tàu rẽ sóng tiến lên, sóng biển tung bọt trắng, lá cờ và cánh buồm bay phần phật, khói nhẹ bay lên.
en: The big ship ploughs through the sea, waves rise and break into white foam around the bow, the ship rocks gently, the flag and the sail flutter in the wind, a light puff of smoke rises from the funnel, then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: crashing waves, wind, a deep ship horn and seagulls.

vi: Ba bạn cùng làm việc thật: bạn trai cúi viết, ngòi bút chạy trên trang vở để lại dòng chữ nhỏ; bạn gái lau bảng bằng giẻ theo vòng tròn, bụi phấn bay nhẹ; bạn gái bên cửa sổ nghiêng bình tưới, dòng nước chảy xuống chậu hoa, lá hoa tươi lên; rồi cả ba về dáng cũ.
en: The classroom comes alive with three real tasks happening at once: the boy at the desk writes steadily, his pen tip moving along the page and leaving small neat grey handwriting strokes that cannot be read; the girl at the blackboard wipes the board with the cloth in big circles and a faint puff of chalk dust drifts down; the girl by the window tilts her watering can and a thin stream of water pours into the flower pot, the leaves glisten and the orange flowers nod. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: the scratch of a pen on paper, the soft swish of a cloth on the blackboard and water trickling into the pot.

vi: Bác bảo vệ vung dùi đánh trống “tùng, tùng, tùng” ba tiếng to, mặt trống rung lên; nghe trống, các bạn đeo cặp chạy nhanh hơn vào trường, cặp nhún nhảy trên lưng; lá cây lớn xào xạc; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The school guard swings the wooden mallet and strikes the big drum three strong beats, the drum skin visibly shudders with each hit; hearing the drum, the children with backpacks run faster toward the school building, their bags bouncing on their backs, the two far children hurry up the steps; the big tree's leaves rustle. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: three deep booming beats of a large traditional Vietnamese school drum (boom, boom, boom), running footsteps on the yard and cheerful children's shouts (no words).

vi: Ngày khai trường: Lan nâng chiếc cặp đen mới lên khoe, bạn gái ghé nhìn rồi hai bạn cười tít mắt; các nhóm bạn phía sau tíu tít trò chuyện, vẫy tay chào nhau; lá cờ trên cột tung bay; xa xa vang tiếng trống khai trường; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: On the first day of school, the girl in the polka-dot shirt proudly lifts her shiny new black schoolbag a little to show it off, her friend leans in to admire it and both girls laugh happily; behind them the groups of pupils chat, turn to each other and wave hello; the red flag on the pole flutters in the breeze. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a festive school drum beating in the distance, happy children's chatter and laughter (no words).

vi: Gió thổi, lá cờ đỏ sao vàng tung bay phần phật trên cột; cây bàng xào xạc, một chiếc lá cam rơi xoay xuống sân; đàn chim én bay lượn qua mái ngói; các bạn trước cửa lớp vẫy tay rồi bước vào lớp; rồi về như tranh cũ.
en: A fresh breeze sweeps across the new school: the red flag with the yellow star unfurls and flaps strongly on the pole, the big tropical almond tree rustles and one orange leaf twirls down onto the yard, a small flock of swallows swoops low over the red tiled roof and away, the pupils in front of the classroom door wave to each other and step toward the door. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a flag flapping in the wind, rustling leaves, swallows twittering and a school drum far away.

vi: Ba bạn nhỏ miền núi bước đi trên đường mòn, túi thổ cẩm đung đưa; bạn gái quàng khăn chỉ tay về ngôi trường phía xa, các bạn cười; suối chảy róc rách qua đá, tán cọ xoè rung trong gió, một chú chim bay qua; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The three mountain children walk along the forest path with lively steps, their woven cloth bags swinging at their sides; the girl in the headscarf points ahead toward the little school in the distance and the other two laugh and nod; the clear stream flows and splashes over the rocks, the big fan-shaped palm leaves sway in the wind and a small bird flies across the hills. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a babbling mountain stream, footsteps on the dirt path, forest birdsong and children's happy giggles (no words).

start: Keep the same corridor, wall, window, the same man, the same schoolbag on the floor and the same style, but the white wall on the right is completely blank with no horse drawing, and the boy now faces the wall with his right arm stretched out, holding a small black stick of charcoal against the blank wall where the horse will be drawn.
vi: Hùng cầm thỏi than vẽ lên tường trắng: từng nét than hiện ra thành đầu, bờm, thân rồi bốn chân con ngựa đang phi; vẽ xong, cậu cất than, quay lại thấy bác đứng nhìn, gãi đầu ngượng nghịu; bác cúi xuống mỉm cười.
en: Drawing animation from the first frame to the last: the boy draws on the blank white wall with the stick of charcoal, and black sketchy charcoal lines appear stroke by stroke exactly where his charcoal moves, forming the horse's head and mane, then its back and belly, then its four galloping legs and its tail, with a little grass under its hooves. When the horse is finished he slips the charcoal into his pocket, turns toward the man who is watching, and scratches the back of his head shyly, while the man leans forward and smiles, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The horse drawing only grows, it is never erased. Sound: the soft scratching of charcoal on a plaster wall and a warm, amused chuckle from the man (no words).

vi: Hai hàng học sinh đi đều bước vào lớp, tay vung nhịp, cặp nhún theo bước chân, hàng vẫn thẳng tắp; dưới chân cột, đàn kiến nhỏ bò lăng xăng lộn xộn mỗi con một hướng; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The two straight lines of pupils march in step toward the classroom door, swinging their arms together in rhythm, their backpacks bobbing with each step, the lines staying perfectly straight; meanwhile at the foot of the porch pillar the tiny ants scurry about in a messy jumble, each running a different way, bumping into each other and turning around. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: rhythmic marching footsteps with a light drum beat keeping time (one, two, one, two, as drum taps only, no voices) and faint tiny ant scuttling.

vi: Hai bạn khoanh tay cúi đầu lễ phép chào cô; cô giáo mỉm cười gật đầu đáp lại, ôm sách bước nhẹ về phía các em; trong lớp, bạn ngồi bên cửa sổ lật một trang sách; hoa ngoài cửa rung rinh; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The two pupils at the door fold their arms and bow their heads politely to greet their teacher; the young teacher in the long blue ao dai smiles warmly, nods back and takes one gentle step toward them holding her book; inside the classroom the boy by the window turns a page of his book; the orange flowers by the door sway in the breeze. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: soft footsteps, a page turning, morning birdsong and a warm gentle hum of approval from the teacher (no words).

vi: Bé chăm chú viết bài, ngòi bút chạy trên trang vở; ngoài cửa sổ mặt trời buổi sớm toả nắng, đàn chim sâu nhỏ sà xuống vườn rau, nhảy lách chách mổ sâu trên lá cải; bé ngẩng lên nhìn chim, mỉm cười rồi lại cúi xuống học.
en: Early morning: the girl writes carefully in her notebook, her pen tip moving across the page and leaving small grey handwriting strokes that cannot be read; outside the window the morning sun glows warmer, the little sparrow-like birds flutter down into the vegetable garden, hop between the cabbages and peck at tiny caterpillars on the leaves, one bird flies off; the girl looks up at the birds for a moment, smiles, then bends back over her notebook in the exact original pose. Sound: lively small birds chirping and twittering, a pen scratching on paper and a rooster crowing far away.

vi: Cò đứng trên cành tre chăm chú đọc sách, lật một trang, gật gù; dưới bụi cây, vạc rúc đầu ngủ say, lưng phập phồng thở đều; cành tre đung đưa, mây trôi chậm.
en: The white stork on the bamboo branch reads its little book attentively, flips one page over with its beak and nods as it reads on; below in the thick bush the grey night heron sleeps soundly with its head tucked in, its back slowly rising and falling as it breathes; the bamboo branch and leaves sway gently and the small clouds drift across the sky. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. The heron never wakes up. Sound: a soft page flip, rustling bamboo leaves and a light breeze, the slow sleepy breathing of the heron.

vi: Bé chấm ngòi bút vào lọ mực, rồi nắn nót viết một dòng vào vở, ngòi bút để lại nét mực nhỏ; bé ngẩng lên mỉm cười nhìn trang vở rồi cúi xuống viết tiếp; con cò ngoài cửa sổ vỗ cánh.
en: The girl dips her pen nib into the small ink pot on the table, then carefully writes along a line of her open notebook, the nib leaving small neat dark handwriting strokes that cannot be read; she lifts her head, smiles at her neat page, then bends down to write again; outside the window the stork flaps its wings once and settles. She ends in the exact original pose. Sound: a tiny clink of the pen on the ink pot, the scratch of a nib on paper and soft birdsong outside.

start: Keep the same ink bottle, purple ink, paper background, shading and style, but the bottle's teal screw cap sits loosely and slightly tilted on top of the bottle mouth, not screwed on; and the fountain pen is taken apart into three separate pieces lying close together in a row along the same diagonal line on the table, with small gaps between them: the gold nib section at the front, the teal barrel with the gold band in the middle, and the teal cap with the gold clip at the back.
vi: Đồ vật tự lắp lại theo thứ tự: thân bút trượt trên mặt bàn tới vặn vào phần ngòi vàng, nắp bút trượt tới cắm vào đuôi bút kêu "tách"; bút xong rồi nắp lọ mực mới thẳng lại và vặn chặt xuống miệng lọ; mọi thứ chỉ trượt ngắn trên bàn, không bay lên, không ra khỏi tranh.
en: Assembly animation from the first frame to the last, in a clear order: first the pen, then the ink bottle. First the teal barrel slides a short distance forward along the table surface and screws onto the gold nib section with two small turns around its own long axis, the gold band lining up; then the teal cap with its gold clip slides a short distance forward along the table and pushes onto the back end of the pen with a crisp click. Only after the pen is complete, the loose teal cap on the ink bottle straightens and screws down onto the bottle with a visible twist, and the purple ink inside sways gently and settles, until everything matches the final illustration exactly. Every part stays inside the picture at all times and moves only a short distance, sliding along the table surface; nothing flies up, nothing floats in the air, nothing leaves the frame, nothing flips, spins or tumbles, and no hand appears. The pen pieces stop exactly in their final places and never overshoot or bounce back. Everything stays fully inside the square picture; nothing enters or leaves through the side edges, and the background never moves. Nothing disappears and reappears, nothing changes its shape, color or pattern, and the plain paper background keeps one color from start to finish. Time only moves forward: the motion never plays backward, never rewinds and never reverses. Sound: soft sliding on paper, small screw-thread clicks, a crisp snap of the pen cap, the twist of the bottle cap and a bright little chime at the end. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Lâm đứng bên bàn, ngón tay dò theo từng dòng chữ, môi mấp máy đọc thầm, gật gù; cậu lật sang trang mới rồi đọc tiếp; kim giây đồng hồ nhích đều.
en: The boy standing at the desk follows the lines of his book with his finger, his lips moving silently as he reads to himself, nodding as he understands; he turns to the next page and carries on reading, while the second hand of the little alarm clock ticks steadily around. Then he returns to the exact original pose. Sound: a steady clock tick-tock and the rustle of a page turning (no voice).

vi: Lâm ngồi ngay ngắn, chấm bút vào lọ mực rồi cúi viết từng dòng vào vở, ngòi bút để lại nét mực nhỏ; cậu liếc nhìn đồng hồ rồi viết tiếp; kim giây đồng hồ nhích đều.
en: The boy sits up straight, dips his pen into the purple ink pot, then bends over his notebook and writes line by line, the nib leaving small neat handwriting strokes that cannot be read; he glances at the little alarm clock, whose second hand ticks steadily, and goes back to writing, ending in the exact original pose. Sound: the scratch of a nib on paper, a tiny clink on the ink pot and a steady clock tick-tock.

vi: Thầy giáo trao gói quà, cậu học trò đưa hai tay đón lấy và cúi đầu cảm ơn; thầy mỉm cười vỗ nhẹ vai em; cả lớp vỗ tay rộn ràng; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The teacher hands over the wrapped prize, the little pupil takes it with both hands and bows his head politely in thanks, the teacher smiles and gives his shoulder a gentle pat; the classmates at their desks clap their hands warmly and bounce a little in their seats. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a warm round of children's applause and a happy little cheer (no words).

vi: Gà trống vươn cổ, vỗ cánh phành phạch, gáy “ò ó o” thật to; mèo mướp trong bếp giật mình mở mắt, vươn vai ngáp dài rồi lại cuộn tròn ngủ tiếp; hoa đại khẽ rung.
en: The rooster stretches up its neck, flaps its wings hard and crows a loud, real rooster crow; in the kitchen doorway the striped cat startles, opens its eyes, stretches its front paws and gives a big yawn, then curls back up and closes its eyes again; the frangipani flowers tremble in the breeze. Then everything settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud natural rooster crow 'cock-a-doodle-doo', wing flaps and a sleepy little cat yawn-meow.

vi: Bé Lâm giơ cao quyển vở, chỉ vào trang vở khoe mẹ, nhún nhảy vui sướng; mẹ cúi xuống xem, mỉm cười gật đầu rồi xoa đầu bé; bé cười tươi; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The little girl lifts her notebook higher and points proudly at the page to show her mother, bouncing on her toes with joy; the mother leans down to look, smiles, nods and gently strokes the girl's hair; the girl beams. Then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: a happy little giggle (no words), a soft warm 'mm' of approval from the mother and a page rustle.

vi: Buổi tối: cậu bé viết bài, bố ghé sát chỉ vào trang vở hướng dẫn rồi gật đầu khen; mẹ trên giường đung đưa ru em bé ngủ; ngọn đèn dầu lung linh, ngoài cửa sổ trăng sáng, dế kêu.
en: A quiet evening at home: the boy writes in his notebook, the father leans closer, points at a line on the page to help him and then nods with an approving smile; on the bed the mother gently rocks the baby in her arms to sleep; the flame of the oil lamp flickers softly and the crescent moon glows outside the window. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: crickets chirping at night, a soft lullaby hum without words, the scratch of a pen.

vi: Trưa hè: mẹ đưa võng nhè nhẹ, tay phe phẩy quạt nan cho em bé ngủ say; con ve trên cây rung cánh kêu ra rả; lá cây đung đưa; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: A hot summer noon: the mother rocks the hammock gently back and forth and waves the paper fan slowly over the sleeping baby, the baby sleeps peacefully and its blanket stirs in the breeze of the fan; on the tree trunk the cicada vibrates its wings as it sings; the leaves sway. Then everything settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a loud summer cicada chorus, a soft creak of the hammock rope, the whoosh of the fan and a tender lullaby hum without words.

vi: Bố đẩy mạnh cái bào dọc tấm ván hai lượt, mỗi lượt một dải vỏ bào cuộn tròn trào ra rồi rơi xuống đống vỏ bào dưới giá; cậu bé nghiêng người nhìn chăm chú, thích thú; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The father pushes the wooden hand plane firmly along the plank twice, and with each stroke a long curly wood shaving curls up out of the plane and drops onto the pile of shavings under the trestle; the boy leans in closer, watching with fascination and a delighted smile. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: the rhythmic 'shhhk' of a hand plane shaving wood and soft wood shavings falling.

vi: Anh vừa đi vừa kéo dây, chiếc ô tô đồ chơi lăn bánh; em bé bám xe tập đi chập chững bước theo, cười khanh khách, giơ tay với theo anh; anh ngoái lại cười với em.
en: The big brother walks slowly forward pulling the string, and the little toy car rolls along behind him on its wheels; the toddler pushes his wooden walker and takes wobbly steps after it, laughing and reaching out his hand toward his brother; the brother looks back and smiles at him. They end in the exact original pose. Sound: toy wheels rattling on the ground, the walker creaking and a baby's delighted giggles (no words).

start: Keep the same thatched house, chinaberry tree with purple flowers, bamboo fence, haystack, drying mat, clay jar, plants, paper background and style, but the two boys (same clothes, same schoolbag, same arm-over-shoulder pose) are further back on the dirt path, just in front of the porch steps between the clay jar and the drying mat, about half their current size because they are further away.
vi: Hai bạn khoác vai nhau đi thật trên lối đất từ trước hiên nhà ra tới ngõ, người to dần, dừng đúng chỗ và đúng dáng như tranh; chỉ mỉm cười, miệng khép, không cười to; vài cánh hoa xoan rơi chậm trong tranh; chỉ một làn khói bếp mỏng sau mái rạ.
en: Walking animation from the first frame to the last: the two boys, arms around each other's shoulders, walk together from the front of the thatched house along the dirt path toward the gate with natural steps, really stepping along the path and growing larger with correct perspective as they come closer, never walking in place, the schoolbag swinging gently at the first boy's side; now and then they glance at each other with small, gentle closed-mouth smiles; they never laugh, never open their mouths wide, and their faces stay friendly and natural, until they reach their positions and match the final illustration exactly, arms around each other's shoulders as in the picture. They stop exactly in that pose and never walk past that spot, and nothing jumps or snaps at the end. A few purple chinaberry petals drift down slowly inside the picture only. The kitchen smoke is only a thin faint wisp rising from behind the thatched roof, never a big white puff, never outside the picture. Everything stays fully inside the square picture; nothing enters or leaves through the side edges, and the background never moves. Nothing disappears and reappears, nothing changes its shape, color or pattern, and the plain paper background keeps one color from start to finish. Time only moves forward. Sound: sandals scuffing softly on the dirt path, birdsong and a rooster crowing far away. No laughter, no speech, no words, no English.

vi: Buổi tối, Hoa đưa võng lưới đều tay ru em, em bé ngủ say; ngọn đèn dầu lung linh; chú mèo dưới gầm bàn vẫy tai, cựa mình rồi ngủ tiếp; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: In the evening, the girl rocks the net hammock gently and steadily, the baby inside sleeps peacefully; the oil lamp's flame flickers and its glow pulses softly; under the table the sleeping cat twitches an ear, stirs and settles back to sleep. Then everything settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a soft lullaby hum without words, the gentle creak of the hammock and night crickets.

vi: Mai cầm chổi quét từng nhát, gom lá vàng vào đống, vài chiếc lá bay lên rồi rơi vào đống; trong bếp, mẹ dội nước rửa nồi, lửa bếp bập bùng; tàu cau đung đưa.
en: The girl sweeps the yard with long strokes of her straw broom, pushing the fallen leaves into the pile, a few leaves flutter up and land on the pile; inside the doorway the mother pours water from the pot into the basin as she washes up, and the fire in the clay stove flickers; the areca palm fronds sway. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: the swish of a straw broom on the ground, rustling dry leaves, splashing water and a crackling cooking fire.

vi: Bà vung tay diễn tả say sưa như đang kể đến đoạn hay, hai cháu gái mở to mắt, chồm người lắng nghe rồi bật cười; em bé trong lòng bà vỗ tay; con thuyền trôi chầm chậm trên sông, tàu dừa đung đưa.
en: The grandmother gestures expressively with her hand as if telling the most exciting part of a story, the two granddaughters lean in with wide eyes, then burst into delighted laughter; the baby on the grandmother's lap claps its little hands; on the river the small boat drifts slowly and the coconut fronds sway. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: gentle river water lapping, rustling palm leaves, the girls' laughter and the baby's giggle (no words).

vi: Bà với tay bẻ quả mướp đang cầm, đưa xuống cho cháu; cô bé đỡ lấy, đặt vào rổ; bà lại vươn tay nắm quả mướp kế bên; hoa mướp vàng rung rinh, ong bay quanh, cá rô quẫy dưới ao làm gợn nước.
en: Picking luffas: the grandmother snaps off the long green luffa she is holding and hands it down to the girl, the girl takes it and lays it in the bamboo basket, then the grandmother reaches up and takes hold of the next hanging luffa on the trellis; the yellow luffa flowers sway, a bee buzzes around them and the little fish in the pond dart about making ripples. It ends in the exact original pose and picture. Sound: a crisp snap of the luffa stem, a bee buzzing, water ripples and a small fish splash.

vi: Bà ngủ trưa say, ngực phập phồng thở đều, mỉm cười trong giấc ngủ; cô cháu phe phẩy quạt nan đều tay, làn gió làm mấy sợi tóc bạc của bà khẽ bay; ngoài cửa sổ cành cam, cành khế đung đưa, một chú chim nhỏ đậu xuống.
en: The grandmother sleeps peacefully at noon, her chest slowly rising and falling and a faint smile on her face; the granddaughter waves the paper fan steadily back and forth, and the breeze lifts a few strands of the grandmother's grey hair; outside the window the orange and star-fruit branches sway and a little bird lands on a branch. Then everything settles back into the exact original pose. The grandmother keeps sleeping the whole time. Sound: the soft rhythmic whoosh of the fan, slow peaceful breathing and quiet birdsong outside.

start: Keep the same schoolhouse, big tree, bushes, the pupils at the windows, paper background and style, but the running boy is further back and to the left, fully inside the picture: he is in the yard just to the right of the foot of the big tree, about two thirds of his current size because he is further away, in the same running pose with the same satchel and clothes.
vi: Minh chạy thật qua sân: từ gốc cây bên trái chạy hớt hải sang phải về phía lớp học, cặp nảy trên hông, mồ hôi văng, tới đúng chỗ trong tranh thì clip dừng; các bạn trong lớp nhoài người ra cửa sổ nhìn, che miệng cười khúc khích; tiếng trống trường vừa điểm.
en: Running animation from the first frame to the last: the boy dashes from beside the big tree across the schoolyard to the right toward the classroom with big, hurried strides, really travelling across the yard and growing a little larger as he comes closer, never running in place, his satchel bouncing against his hip and little sweat drops flying from his hair, until he reaches his position mid-stride at the very last moment and matches the final illustration exactly; he never runs past that spot. At the windows the pupils lean forward to watch him and cover their mouths with quiet giggles, and the leaves of the big tree flutter. Everything stays fully inside the square picture; nothing enters or leaves through the side edges, and the background never moves. Time only moves forward. Sound: the last deep beats of a Vietnamese wooden school drum, quick running footsteps on the hard yard with panting breath, and soft children's giggles. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Diều hâu trên cành rướn cổ rình, kêu “chiêm chiếp” sắc lạnh; gà mẹ dang rộng cánh, cục cục báo động; đàn gà con hốt hoảng chạy ùa vào núp dưới cánh mẹ, ló đầu ra; diều hâu vẫn đậu trên cành, không sà xuống.
en: Danger: the hawk on the branch above stretches its neck, glares down and gives a sharp shrill cry; the white mother hen spreads her wings even wider, ruffles her feathers and clucks a loud alarm; the yellow chicks run in panic and dive under her wings, then peek out with their little heads. The hawk stays perched on the branch the whole time and never swoops down. Everything ends in the exact original picture. Sound: a sharp hawk screech, a mother hen's loud alarm clucking and frightened chicks peeping.

start: Turn this into the same picture as an uncoloured pencil sketch: keep exactly the same composition and all the same black ink outlines of the village, river, rice fields, bamboo, houses, school, kapok tree, sun and flag, but with NO colour at all, only black lines on the plain ivory paper.
vi: Bức tranh vẽ quê hương tự tô màu: từ bản phác nét đen, màu sáp lần lượt phủ lên – đồng lúa xanh, dòng sông xanh, lũy tre, mái ngói đỏ, cây gạo hoa đỏ, ông mặt trời đỏ và lá cờ đỏ sao vàng – như có bàn tay em bé đang tô.
en: Colouring animation from the first frame to the last: the black-line sketch of the village gets coloured in step by step with crayon strokes, as if a child is colouring it: first the rice fields turn fresh green, then the winding river turns blue, the bamboo and trees turn green, the roofs turn red-orange, the kapok tree's blossoms turn bright red, the sun turns red and the flag turns red with a yellow star, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The lines never change, only colour is added and never removed. Sound: the soft scratching of crayons on paper and light cheerful birdsong.

vi: Làng quê ven sông: con thuyền nhỏ dập dềnh theo sóng, mặt nước gợn lăn tăn, một con cá nhảy lên làm tóe nước; tàu dừa và tàu chuối đung đưa, khói bếp mỏng bay lên từ mái tranh; rồi về như cũ.
en: A riverside village in the south: the small boat bobs and rocks on the gentle waves tied to its post, ripples run across the water and a little fish leaps out with a splash, the coconut fronds and banana leaves sway in the breeze and a thin wisp of cooking smoke curls up from the thatched roof. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: water lapping against the boat, a small fish splash, rustling palm fronds and birds.

vi: Hồ Gươm: mặt hồ gợn sóng nhẹ, một chú rùa lớn nổi lên gần Tháp Rùa, ngóc đầu nhìn rồi lặn xuống làm vòng sóng loang ra; lá cây ven hồ rung rinh, chim bay qua; rồi về như cũ.
en: Hoan Kiem Lake comes alive: the calm water ripples softly, a big old turtle slowly rises to the surface near the little tower on the islet, lifts its head to look around, then dives back down, leaving circles of ripples spreading across the lake; the trees by the shore rustle and two birds fly across the sky. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture, the lake calm again. Sound: gentle water ripples, a soft splash as the turtle dives, rustling leaves and birdsong.

start: Keep the same flagpole, the same blue sky, the same white clouds and the same style, but the red flag with the yellow star is not at the top: it hangs folded and limp at the very bottom of the pole, near the lower edge of the picture.
vi: Chào cờ: lá cờ đỏ sao vàng từ chân cột được kéo lên từ từ theo dây, lên tới đỉnh thì gió thổi, cờ tung bay phấp phới đúng như tranh.
en: Flag-raising animation from the first frame to the last: the folded red flag at the bottom of the pole is hoisted steadily up the flagpole on its rope, rising all the way to the very top, and as it reaches the top the wind catches it and it unfurls and waves proudly, the big yellow star shining, while the white clouds drift, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Sound: the creak of the rope pulley, then strong wind flapping the flag.

vi: Cô giáo đọc bài trong sách, chỉ tay lên bảng; các bạn ngồi ngay ngắn, vài bạn giơ tay phát biểu, cô mỉm cười gật đầu; một bạn lật trang sách; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The teacher in the orange ao dai reads from her book and gestures toward the blackboard, several pupils raise their hands eagerly to answer, the teacher smiles and nods at one of them, another pupil turns a page of the book on his desk, the flowers in the vase on the teacher's table nod. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a quiet classroom with pages turning, the rustle of raised sleeves and a soft warm murmur of the class (no words).

vi: Bến cảng lúc bình minh: mặt trời toả nắng lấp lánh trên sông, chiếc xuồng nhỏ khua mái chèo trôi qua, những con tàu trắng khẽ dập dềnh, ống khói nhả khói; đàn én vỗ cánh bay về phía biển; rồi về như cũ.
en: The old harbour at sunrise: the sun glows and its light sparkles on the river, the little rowing boat glides along as its oar dips, the white ships bob gently at the quay and a puff of steam rises from a funnel, the flock of swallows flaps and swoops toward the sea. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a deep distant ship horn, water lapping, the splash of an oar and swallows twittering.

vi: Nhà máy gạch: khói trắng cuồn cuộn bốc lên từ ống khói lò nung; các chú công nhân chuyền tay nhau từng viên gạch đỏ, xếp lên thùng xe tải; chiếc xe phía cổng nổ máy, nhích bánh; rồi về như cũ.
en: The brickworks at work: thick white smoke billows up from the kiln chimney; the workers pass red bricks from hand to hand in a quick rhythm and stack them neatly onto the back of the truck, the worker on the right lifts a brick from the pile; the loaded truck by the gate rumbles, puffs exhaust and rolls forward a little. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: the clink of bricks being stacked, a rumbling truck engine and the roar of the kiln.

vi: Đoàn tàu hải quân rẽ sóng tiến lên, mũi tàu tung bọt trắng, cờ đỏ trên tàu bay phần phật; mặt trời buổi sớm lấp lánh trên sóng; hải âu chao lượn, kêu vang; rồi về như cũ.
en: The navy ships cruise forward in a line, their bows cutting through the waves and throwing up white foam, the red flags on the masts flap in the sea wind, the morning sun sparkles on the rolling waves and the seagulls glide and wheel overhead. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: rolling ocean waves, a deep ship horn, flags flapping and seagulls crying.

vi: Mùa gặt: các cô bác nắm khóm lúa, vung liềm cắt xoẹt, ôm lúa đặt lên bó; bông lúa vàng rung rinh; xa xa chiếc xe chở lúa chạy dọc đường làng; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: Harvest time: the farmers in conical hats grab handfuls of golden rice stalks, cut them with a swish of their sickles and lay the cut rice onto the bundles, moving forward in a row; the ripe golden ears sway in the breeze and far away the truck loaded with rice drives along the village road. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: the crisp swish of sickles through rice stalks, rustling rice and a distant truck engine.

vi: Gió thổi, lũy tre cong mình kẽo kẹt, lá tre xào xạc; hai chú chim trên cành nhảy nhót, hót líu lo; chú trâu dưới gốc tre nhai cỏ, vẫy tai, ngoe nguẩy đuôi; rồi về như cũ.
en: The wind blows through the bamboo grove: the tall bamboo stems bend and creak, the leaves rustle, the two little birds on the branch hop about and sing, and the water buffalo lying in the shade chews its grass slowly, flicks its ears and swishes its tail. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: creaking bamboo, rustling leaves, cheerful birdsong and the buffalo munching grass.

start: Keep the same leaves, branch, paper background and style, but the longan cluster is small and unripe: small hard green fruits on the stems, and on the ground in front there are only two small closed green longans, nothing peeled.
vi: Chùm nhãn xanh nhỏ lớn dần, căng tròn rồi chín vàng nâu; quả nhãn dưới đất vỏ nứt và tự bóc ra, lộ cùi trắng trong mọng nước và hạt đen nhánh.
en: Ripening animation from the first frame to the last: the small green longans on the cluster swell round and ripen, their skins turning from green to golden brown with tiny speckles, the two longans in front grow and ripen too and the shell of one of them cracks and peels back, revealing the juicy translucent white flesh and the shiny black seed, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The fruits only grow and ripen, they never shrink or turn green again. Sound: soft rustling leaves, gentle growing sounds and a tiny crack of the shell.

start: Keep the same branch, leaves, the same cut half jackfruit, the same plate of yellow pods, paper background and style, but the whole jackfruit hanging on the stalk is still small, young and dark green, about a third of its final size.
vi: Quả mít non xanh trên cuống lớn dần, phình to, gai nở ra và vỏ chuyển vàng xanh khi chín; múi mít vàng trên đĩa thơm lừng, một chú ong bay tới đậu.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the small young dark-green jackfruit on its stalk slowly swells and grows bigger and bigger, its spiky bumps widen and its skin ripens from dark green to yellow-green, while a little bee buzzes over to the golden pods on the plate, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The jackfruit only grows, it never shrinks. Sound: a soft growing creak, leaves rustling and a little bee buzz.

start: Keep the same vine, leaves, tendrils, yellow flowers, paper background and style, but there is no big wax gourd: only a tiny young green fruit, finger-sized, at the base of a flower on the vine.
vi: Quả bí non bé xíu nơi gốc hoa lớn dần, dài ra, căng tròn và phủ lớp phấn trắng như tranh; hoa bí vàng đung đưa, tua cuốn xoắn lại.
en: Growth animation from the first frame to the last: the tiny young wax gourd at the base of the flower grows longer and plumper, stretching out across the leaves, and its green skin becomes covered with a soft white powdery bloom, while the yellow flowers sway and the curly tendrils twist, until it matches the final illustration exactly. The gourd only grows, it never shrinks, and no flower grows on a leaf. Sound: soft rustling leaves and a gentle growing sound.

start: Keep the same branch shape, the same young leaves, the same pale spring sky and style, but no flower is open yet: every flower is a small closed green-and-yellow bud on the branch.
vi: Tết đến: những nụ mai trên cành căng dần, hé lộ sắc vàng rồi lần lượt xòe nở thành bông mai năm cánh vàng rực, nhị hoa rung rinh; hoa đã nở thì giữ nguyên, không khép lại.
en: Blooming animation from the first frame to the last: one after another the closed buds on the apricot-blossom branch swell, show a crack of yellow and open into bright yellow five-petal flowers with delicate stamens, the young leaves unfold a little and the branch sways in a spring breeze, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Every flower, once open, stays open: no flower ever closes back into a bud. Sound: a soft spring breeze, gentle little popping sounds as the flowers open and distant birdsong.

start: Keep the same pear tree branches, the same distant mountains, the same meadow and style, but the branches are bare with only tiny closed buds and no white flowers and no leaves, and the grass is pale and short.
vi: Xuân về: cỏ non xanh mướt lan khắp bãi tới chân trời, cành lê khẳng khiu đâm chồi lá non, nụ lê bung nở thành những bông hoa trắng; hoa nở rồi thì giữ nguyên.
en: Spring arrives, from the first frame to the last: fresh green grass spreads and grows across the meadow all the way to the horizon, little white wildflowers appear in the grass, the bare pear branches sprout young green leaves and the tiny buds open into white pear blossoms, and any thin frame border line fades away, until it matches the final illustration exactly. Growth only moves forward: flowers stay open and leaves stay on. Sound: a soft spring breeze, birdsong and gentle rustling grass.

vi: Vùng mỏ ven biển: những chiếc thuyền buồm căng gió lướt trên sóng, chú ngư dân giữ lái, khoang đầy cá lấp lánh; tàu chở than ngoài khơi nhả khói, cần cẩu ở bến quay; hải âu lượn; rồi về như cũ.
en: The mining bay comes alive: the sailing junks glide over the waves with their orange sails full of wind, the fishermen hold the tiller and the baskets full of silver fish glint in the sun; the coal ship out at sea puffs smoke from its funnel and the crane at the port swings slowly; seagulls circle over the rocky cliffs. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: waves and wind in the sails, a distant ship horn, a creaking crane and seagulls crying.

vi: Hai cô gái miền núi đeo gùi bước trên lối mòn, quay sang nhau cười nói; gió núi thổi, hoa mơ trắng rụng lả tả, bắp chuối rừng đỏ đung đưa; mây trắng trôi qua sườn núi; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The two mountain girls carrying baskets on their backs walk along the rocky path with steady steps, turn to each other and laugh; a mountain breeze blows, white apricot petals drift down from the blossoming branches, the red wild banana flower sways and a strip of white mist floats across the hillside. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps on the stony path, a mountain breeze, forest birdsong and the girls' soft laughter (no words).

vi: Sa Pa: mây trắng bồng bềnh trôi qua các đỉnh núi, sương mỏng lướt trên ruộng bậc thang, nước ruộng lấp lánh; cánh đào hồng bay theo gió; khói bếp mỏng lên từ mái nhà; rồi về như cũ.
en: The Sa Pa highlands come alive: soft white clouds drift slowly past the mountain peaks, a thin mist glides over the terraced rice fields and the water in the terraces glimmers, pink peach-blossom petals float down in the breeze, the pine trees sway and thin wisps of cooking smoke rise from the cottage roofs. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a cool mountain wind, distant birdsong and the faint trickle of water between the terraces.

vi: Nhà Gấu trong rừng: gấu bố đứng hai chân khịt khịt mũi, gầm một tiếng trầm; gấu mẹ lặc lè bước tới; hai gấu con vật nhau lăn lộn trên cỏ; gấu con trên cành bò dọc cành, vịn chặt nhìn xuống; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The bear family in the old forest: the father bear standing on his hind legs sniffs the air with his nose up and gives a deep rumbling growl, the mother bear lumbers forward a few heavy steps, the two cubs on the grass tumble and wrestle playfully, and the cub up in the tree crawls along the branch, hugs it tightly and peers down. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: a deep bear growl, playful cub squeals and grunts, rustling leaves and forest birds.

vi: Núi rừng: mây trắng trôi quanh đỉnh núi đá nhọn, một con đại bàng sải cánh lượn vòng; suối dưới chân núi chảy róc rách tung bọt qua các tảng đá; cây rừng trên sườn núi rì rào trong gió; rồi về như cũ.
en: The mountains and forest come alive: white clouds drift around the sharp rocky peak, an eagle with outstretched wings glides in a wide circle over the pass, the stream at the foot of the mountain rushes and foams over the rocks and the forest on the slopes sways and rustles in the wind. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: rushing stream water, wind through the forest and a distant eagle cry.

vi: Bãi biển buổi sáng: các chú ngư dân dồn sức đẩy, kéo dây lôi con thuyền lên bãi cát một đoạn; sóng trắng xô vào bờ; những cánh buồm trắng ngoài xa lướt nhẹ như đàn bướm; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: A bright morning beach: the fishermen push and heave together and the man in the conical hat pulls hard on the rope, dragging the wooden boat a little further up the sand; white-foamed waves roll onto the shore and the white sails far out at sea glide gently like a flock of butterflies. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: crashing waves, the boat hull scraping on sand, the fishermen's effort grunts (no words) and seagulls.

start: Keep the same rice field, path, trees, mountains, village, clouds, paper background and style, but the three skylarks are low down, just above the rice field in the middle distance in the right half of the picture, below the mountains, wings spread as they take off from the rice, nowhere near their current places in the sky; same size as now.
vi: Ba chú chiền chiện cất cánh từ ruộng lúa, vỗ cánh bay vút thẳng lên cao, vừa bay vừa hót lảnh lót, tới đúng chỗ trên trời như tranh; lúa chỉ đung đưa nhẹ. Không vệt trắng, không vẽ gì đè lên cảnh.
en: Flight animation from the first frame to the last: exactly three skylarks take off from the rice field and climb steeply up into the sky with quick wing beats, really travelling upward across the picture and never hovering or flapping in place, singing as they rise, until they reach their places high in the sky near the clouds and match the final illustration exactly; below them the rice ears only sway very gently. There are always exactly three birds and none of them leaves the picture. The birds keep the same size as in the picture and never fly toward the camera. They arrive at their places exactly at the last moment and never fly past them or snap back. The trees, the path, the field and the sky stay completely clean and clear, exactly like the illustration; nothing is drawn over the scene. Everything stays fully inside the square picture; nothing enters or leaves through the side edges, and the background never moves. Nothing disappears and reappears, nothing changes its shape, color or pattern, and the plain paper background keeps one color from start to finish. Time only moves forward. Sound: the real song of skylarks, a long, bright, continuous trilling and warbling, loud and clear, and a soft rustle of rice leaves. No speech, no words, no English.

vi: Bến thuyền: hai chú ngư dân khiêng thúng cá đầy bằng đòn gánh bước nhịp nhàng lên bờ, cá bạc lấp lánh; chú trên thuyền chuyển thêm thúng cá; thuyền buồm dập dềnh, tàu dừa đung đưa; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The fishing harbour is busy: the two fishermen carry the heavy basket full of silver fish on a bamboo pole across their shoulders, walking in rhythm up the beach as the pole bounces, the fish glinting; the man in the boat lifts another basket of fish onto the side; the sailboats bob on the water and the coconut palms sway. Then everyone settles back into the exact original pose. Sound: footsteps on wet sand, the creak of the carrying pole, splashing waves and seagulls.

vi: Bố chỉ tay lên chùm xoài cát vàng trĩu cành, bé gái ngước nhìn theo, reo lên, vỗ tay nhảy cẫng; gió thổi, chùm xoài đung đưa, một chú chim đậu xuống cành; rồi về dáng cũ.
en: The father points up at the clusters of ripe golden mangoes heavy on the branches, the little girl follows his finger, gasps with delight, claps her hands and hops on her toes; a breeze sways the mango clusters gently and a small bird lands on a branch near the fruit. Then they settle back into the exact original pose. Sound: rustling mango leaves, a happy little cheer from the girl (no words) and birdsong.

vi: Gió biển thổi, tàu dừa xòe như những bàn tay vẫy gọi, chùm dừa khẽ đung đưa; sóng biển lăn tăn vỗ bờ cát, ánh trăng lấp lánh trên mặt nước; mây trắng trôi qua vầng trăng; rồi về như cũ.
en: A sea breeze blows: the long coconut fronds wave like open hands beckoning, the cluster of coconuts sways gently, small waves roll in and lap the sandy shore, the moonlight shimmers on the water and white clouds drift slowly past the full moon. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: gentle waves on the beach, the rustle of coconut fronds in the wind.

vi: Mùa xuân về vườn: chích chòe ngửa cổ hót vang, chào mào vểnh mào hót líu lo, khướu nghiêng đầu đáp lời, chim sâu nhỏ chuyền cành, một chú chim bay lượn qua; cánh hoa mận trắng rơi lả tả; rồi về như cũ.
en: Spring in the garden: the magpie-robin throws back its head and sings loudly, the red-whiskered bulbul raises its crest and trills, the grey laughingthrush tilts its head and answers, the tiny white-eye hops from twig to twig and the yellow bird flutters across; white plum petals drift down in the breeze. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a rich spring chorus of different birds singing and trilling, a soft breeze.

vi: Đồng cỏ Ba Vì: con bò sữa gần nhất gặm cỏ, ngẩng đầu kêu “ò” một tiếng dài, vẫy đuôi; các con bò khác thong thả bước, nhai cỏ, phe phẩy đuôi đuổi ruồi; cỏ xanh rì rào, mây trôi qua núi; rồi về như cũ.
en: The dairy farm at Ba Vi: the nearest black-and-white dairy cow tears up a mouthful of grass, lifts its head and gives a long deep moo, then swishes its tail; the other cows stroll a few slow steps, chew and flick their tails at flies; the green grass ripples in the breeze and clouds drift past the mountain. Then everything settles back into the exact original picture. Sound: a real deep cow moo, grass being munched and a soft breeze.

start: Keep the same steel pylons, power lines, rice field, river, mountains, village, clouds, paper background and style, but the two swallows are not on the wire yet: they are flying in the sky at the far right, just below the clouds, wings swept back, the same size as now.
vi: Đôi chim én từ phía chân trời bay tới: chao liệng qua bầu trời, lần lượt đậu xuống dây điện đúng chỗ trong tranh, dây khẽ võng xuống rồi nảy nhẹ; hai chú xếp cánh, há mỏ ríu rít với nhau. Cột điện và dây điện đứng yên; gió làm lúa gợn sóng, mặt sông lấp lánh.
en: Flight animation from the first frame to the last: the two swallows fly in from the right side of the sky with quick, graceful wing beats and swooping glides, really travelling across the sky toward the power line, never hovering in place, and land one after the other on the wire at their exact places, the wire dipping and bouncing gently under them; they fold their long wings, then open their beaks and twitter to each other, until everything matches the final illustration exactly. The steel pylons and the power lines stay perfectly still and unchanged; only the wind ripples the rice field and the river glints. The swallows keep the same small size as in the picture and never fly toward the camera. Once they land they stay on the wire and never take off again; nothing snaps or jumps at the end. Everything stays fully inside the square picture; nothing enters or leaves through the side edges, and the background never moves. Time only moves forward. Sound: the real twittering of barn swallows, clear and lively, and a soft wind over the field. No speech, no words, no English.
